jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
Remote - Canada

Description

What You'll Do:

As a Project Manager at GeologicAI, you will be accountable for end-to-end delivery of client projects, from contract execution through completion. You will act as the central point of coordination between our clients and internal teams, ensuring work is delivered predictably, clearly, and to a high standard. This is not a hands-on technical role: our Project Managers succeed by orchestrating, driving alignment, governance, and decision-making across Operations, Processing, Geoscience, Engineering, and Data teams. You are accountable for the project, without doing everyone else's job.

What We'll Love About You:

You are a clear, structured communicator who stays calm under pressure and enjoys bringing order to complexity. You are a systems thinker who understands the dependencies across scanning, processing, geoscience, products, and delivery, and you orchestrate the system rather than jumping in to fix it. You are comfortable leading without direct authority, you protect role boundaries, and you escalate instead of absorbing load. Whether you are early in your PM career or an experienced delivery leader, you bring a pragmatic, accountable, low-ego mindset focused on delivery excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Own overall project delivery, outcomes, and accountability from contract execution through project close-out
Lead all client-facing project communications, including weekly syncs, progress reports, and escalation channels, giving clients clear visibility into project status, upcoming deliverables, risks and mitigations, and data availability
Build and maintain project plans, roadmaps, milestones, and delivery cadence using internal and standardized workflows
Establish project KPIs at kickoff (turnaround time, data-release cadence, production targets) and track performance against them
Coordinate cross-functional teams so each has clear priorities, context, timelines, and escalation paths
Oversee data delivery to ensure processing, QAQC, and exports meet agreed cadence, product specifications, and client formats, using checklist-based readiness reviews
Identify, categorize, prioritize, and escalate issues based on client impact, and communicate clear resolution timelines and ownership back to the client
Ensure alignment with contracted scope (POs / SOWs), monitor project costs, meterage, and change-order requirements, and support invoicing accuracy with Sales and Finance
Manage scope changes in coordination with Sales and Account Management, and feed upsell opportunities to Sales
Produce and maintain standardized documentation, including kickoff packs, stakeholder maps, communications plans, weekly client and internal updates, monthly KPI reviews, risk registers, change logs, and end-of-project summaries
Promote a safe, compliant, and predictable delivery culture, communicating safety expectations and escalating concerns to HSE or Operations

Travel Requirements:
Travel of up to 25%, including regular site visits to client operations to build and maintain client relationships
Flexible / hybrid work arrangement when not on site

Skills, Education, and Experience

Must Have Skills, Education, and Experience:
Bilingual (English / French)
Based in Canada within easy reach of a major airport hub (for example, Calgary, Toronto, Vancouver, Edmonton or Montreal)
Experience in project management, operations coordination, engineering services, or technical programmes in complex environments (we hire at multiple experience levels, from early-career to senior)
Clear, structured communication skills, especially under pressure, with the ability to manage client expectations proactively
Strong organisational and coordination skills, with a disciplined approach to planning, tracking, and documentation
Systems thinking: the ability to understand dependencies and handoffs across multiple teams
Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority
Discipline around role boundaries and escalation, with a calm, pragmatic, and accountable mindset

Assets:
Experience delivering projects in the mining, exploration, geoscience, or energy sectors
Based in Calgary, with the ability to work hybrid from our Calgary office
Familiarity with geological data workflows (core scanning, data processing, QAQC, and data products)
Experience managing project scope against POs / SOWs, change orders, and project budgets
Experience establishing KPIs, risk registers, and reporting frameworks across multiple concurrent projects
Experience leading complex programmes or helping shape delivery standards across an organization

Benefits from Working at GeologicAI

What You'll Love About Us:

We're a fast-growing well-funded company working on interesting products that are making a difference to the world. Our products and services are helping find the hydrocarbons that power our world today, and the metals and minerals required for the energy transition of tomorrow.

We offer: A casual and fun work environment
Flexible schedule and opportunities for remote work
Extended health and dental benefits
Robots with lasers!

We're grateful for the interest in our roles. Because of the volume of applications we receive, only those selected for an interview will be contacted, and we aren't able to respond to enquiries about individual applications.

Additional information: Accessibility: We want our hiring process to work for everyone. If you need any adjustments or accommodations at any stage, email us at hrinquiries@geologicai.com so we can make arrangements.
Protect yourself from recruitment fraud: GeologicAI will never ask you for payment, banking details, or identity documents in order to apply or interview. Every message from us comes from an @geologicai.com address. If something looks off, contact us at hrinquiries@geologicai.com before responding.
A note for agencies: We do not accept unsolicited resumes. Any candidate submitted without a signed agreement in place will be treated as a direct application, and no fee will be payable.

jobs.title: (Remote) Project Manager
jobs.description:
Systems & Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager

Systems and Software (www.ssivt.com), a division of Harris Computer Systems, is a software development company headquartered in Winooski, VT. S&S's single focus is on delivering horizontally and vertically scalable customer service solutions to the utility industry. Our reputation is one of market-leading software, exceptional solution delivery, and a customer-focused organization.

For a utility, a Customer Information System (CIS) is more than just a collection of records, it's a lifeline between the utility and its most important asset, its customers. From turn-on to move-out, no other system will have the impact on the customer experience that the CIS does, so ensuring that this solution offers the breadth of scope and responsiveness that modern consumers require is a critical priority. Through our flagship product, enQuesta, S&S meets this need for our electric, water, sewer and gas customers by combining an intuitive design with powerful technology. The enQuesta solution not only presents a modern, innovative face for the utility to the end customers, but also enables the utilities to take advantage of the solution's open architecture when developing future programs and initiatives.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 75%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. This opportunity can be performed remotely or from our office in Winooski, VT. Travel, depending on the project(s).

Salary

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Project Coordination & Management

Coordinate components of utility CIS software implementation projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Maintain and update detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets to ensure projects remain on track.
Identify and report issues, risks, or delays in a timely manner to the PMO Manager and stakeholders for resolution.
Provide clear communication and regular updates on project progress to the PMO Manager and project teams.

Process Support & Standardization

Assist the PMO Manager in maintaining project management documentation and processes to ensure consistency across projects.
Adhere to established project management methodologies, including Waterfall and Agile, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with project management practices and help identify areas for administrative efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication

Maintain consistent communication with internal teams, including R&D, Sales, and Delivery, to ensure alignment on project tasks.

Financial Tracking & Reporting

Assist in monitoring project budgets, ensuring expenses are tracked against financial goals.
Track and report on project status, timelines, and financials, generating regular status reports for the PMO Manager.
Collaborate with finance teams to verify financial data aligns with forecasts.

Performance Monitoring

Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as project delivery timelines and budget variance.
Assist in analyzing project execution data to contribute ideas for enhancing team efficiency.
Support the PMO Manager in preparing project status updates and gathering data for issue escalation.
Participate in client-facing discussions, documenting meeting minutes and action items to ensure customer satisfaction.

What We Are Looking For

1-3 years of experience in project management or a related role, preferably within software implementations or technical environments.
Experience in managing project budgets ranging from $10k to over $2.5M.
Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Spira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Clarizen.
Basic understanding of Waterfall project management; exposure to Agile methodologies is a plus.
Experience tracking project financials or budgets is preferred.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with team members and customers.
Ability to work collaboratively and manage tasks with guidance.
Strong problem-solving abilities with a focus on learning and delivering results.
Experience working in a team-oriented environment, collaborating with cross-functional groups such as Sales, R&D, and Delivery.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on organization and process.
Position may require travel as high as 75% in North America without restriction.
Frequent communication through Teams, phone calls, and email to stay connected with remote teams and leadership.

What We Can Offer

3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
Lifestyle rewards
Remote work and more!

About Systems & Software

Systems & Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems & Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

About Harris

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

jobs.title: Payroll Implementation Manager | Sweden
jobs.description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

Responsible for overseeing the successful implementation and data migration of payroll systems for Deel’s clients. You will lead and manage the full payroll implementation process, ensuring that clients’ data is accurately transferred, systems are properly configured, and the transition is seamless. You’ll collaborate closely with internal teams and external stakeholders, guiding clients through the setup and migration phases, while offering ongoing support and training.

Responsibilities

Project Set-up – work with our onboarding team and clients to organize and run kick off meetings, and deliver our implementation. Create, maintain and manage project plans to deliver the successful roll-out of clients.
Client and Project Management – Support project review calls (internal and external), coordinating and delivering on the project streams. Refer and manage any changes to the scope of work and delivery schedule.
Payroll Process Requirements – Define and set-up the agreed client payroll processes, establishing all of the payroll and data requirements. Ensure each client payroll calendar is managed timely and effectively.
Documentation - Maintain detailed project documentation, including project plans, status reports, and process documentation.
System set-up and parallel payroll process – define, agree and configure all interfaces, reports and systems configurations to successfully deliver the parallel and live payroll for month 1 and 2, if applicable.
Go-live transition, Sign-off and documentation – Work with the client to sign-off on the project and document all of the client specific needs and processes ensuring validation and confirmation on the project implementation. Responsible for generating reports to analyze, audit, and reconcile payroll data.
Reports- Mapping of GL reports if required
Communication – Act as the point of contact for all payroll project matters for the client.
The role is primarily autonomous and will set priorities and manage the project appropriately. Regular status reporting to senior leadership is required, with this role taking ownership for appropriately escalating issues where necessary. Schedule and attend weekly client calls to report on project status, identifying any risks, actions, issues and dependencies
Project Management - Lead and manage the end-to-end implementation of a global payroll system, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
Client Management - Gather key requirements from clients to facilitate the onboarding process, and guide them through the technical payroll aspects of onboarding in a professional, clear manner.
Requirements Gathering - Collaborate with HR, Finance, and other stakeholders to gather payroll requirements
Compliance - Ensure that all payroll processes adhere to local tax and labor laws, keeping up-to-date with any changes.
Data Migration - Oversee the migration of payroll data from legacy systems to the new global payroll system, ensuring data accuracy and security.
Testing - Develop and execute a comprehensive testing plan to identify and resolve system issues, ensuring a smooth transition to the new payroll system.
Change Management - Implement change management strategies to ensure a seamless transition for employees and HR teams.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in global payroll implementation and payroll operations.
Strong knowledge of payroll processes and compliance across your designated location.
Experience with payroll systems and software.
Client-facing project management experience and ability to manage multiple projects.
Project management certification (e.g., PMP) is a plus.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.
Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.
We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. You will also support the development of team members through mentoring, coaching, and knowledge sharing.

Consultation and Planning: Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to create project plans, define deliverables, and establish timelines.
Project Oversight: Manage project execution to ensure deliverables are completed accurately, on schedule, and in accordance with project requirements.
Client Communication: Provide regular status updates, reporting, and consultation throughout the project lifecycle.

Issue Resolution: Investigate and resolve issues involving hosted or delivered data while maintaining data integrity and service quality.

Mentorship and Training: Mentor project team members and support the development of technical and project management capabilities.

Must be able to work second shift - 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM CT
Experience managing complex eDiscovery projects and ESI workflows.
Demonstrated experience independently managing projects in Relativity.
Experience serving as a primary client contact and managing stakeholder relationships.
Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, review platforms, databases, and related business software.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining quality standards and meeting deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with clients, stakeholders, and project teams.
Experience leading, mentoring, or developing team members.

Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or regulatory matters.
Experience implementing process improvements or workflow efficiencies.
Experience working with legal service providers, law firms, or corporate legal departments.

What You Will Do

Lead Customer Projects

Serve as the primary customer contact from project kickoff through final delivery and closeout.
Establish project goals, key milestones, communication plans, and escalation paths.
Lead customer meetings, status reviews, milestone discussions, and project closeouts.
Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and dependable execution.

Drive Project Execution

Coordinate activities across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Finance, and Customer Service teams.

Escalate commercial risks and recommend solutions to leadership when necessary.

Facilitate collaboration across teams to solve complex cross-functional challenges.

The team is responsible for delivering complex automation and software solutions that sit at the intersection of robotics, intelligent systems, and large-scale operational execution. Comprised of talented software engineers, roboticists, and systems engineers, the organization develops technologies that optimize how inventory moves through highly automated environments.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Asset Management Program Manager - Power Generation

Location:

Houston, TX / Eastern PA

FLSA Classification

Exempt

Job Description

As an Asset Management Program Manager / Senior Project Manager
within Orbital’s Asset Integrity business unit, you will lead multi-year, multi-site inspection and asset management programs for industrial clients, with an emphasis on Power Generation. You will own program execution, client coordination, and continuous improvement while managing the scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety of assigned inspection projects and asset management activities. You will work alongside engineering teams to share inspection findings, coordinate interfaces, and support client planning.

The position is primarily remote-based, with a mix of in-office, periodic visits to client facilities, and occasional travel to support the program.

Essential Functions

Lead Inspection & Asset Management Programs

Develop and lead inspection and asset management programs for structural and other infrastructure assets across multiple facilities.
Serve as the primary client contact for assigned programs, aligning execution with asset lifecycle goals, risk tolerance, and operational priorities.
Guide inspection strategies, risk-based prioritization, and program improvements; provide asset condition information to support client- and engineering-led repair and capital planning.
Hire, supervise, and develop inspection and asset management staff; establish clear goals, provide guidance, and conduct performance reviews for direct reports.

Deliver Consistent Program Execution

Manage concurrent inspection projects and asset management activities, maintaining accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety.
Plan and coordinate inspectors, program staff, and inspection subcontractors; align inspection activities with engineering interfaces without directing engineering or design work.
Review inspection reports and program deliverables for completeness, consistency, and alignment with requirements; coordinate engineering technical reviews when needed.
Lead inspection quality reviews and program status meetings, and contribute inspection findings and program context to engineering-led technical discussions.

Strengthen Quality & Continuous Improvement

Improve inspection procedures, reporting standards, and program workflows in collaboration with responsible technical teams; support engineering-defined inspection requirements without owning engineering or design standards.
Ensure assigned inspection and asset management activities follow Orbital’s Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable client, regulatory, and industry requirements.
Promote consistent, repeatable, and defensible inspection and asset condition data across facilities and programs.

Build Long-Term Client Partnerships

Develop and strengthen long-term client relationships.
Collaborate with Orbital leadership and Strategic Partners on program renewals, expansions, and new asset management opportunities.
Develop scopes, execution strategies, schedules, and cost estimates for inspection and asset management proposals; provide supporting program information for engineering-led proposals.

Other Duties

Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice .

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Structural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university or a minimum of 10 years of directly relevant Asset Management or Project Management experience
Minimum of 10 years of experience, preferably within a consulting engineering or asset integrity environment
Experience supporting asset-intensive industries such as power generation, oil and gas, refining, chemical processing, manufacturing, steel, mining, or materials processing.
A strong understanding of inspection planning, risk-based prioritization, asset lifecycle decision-making, and program governance.
Proficiency with project management tools, project controls, and scheduling software such as Microsoft Project.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with operations, maintenance, engineering, and management personnel.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and collaborate in a consulting environment.
Ability to commute to local client facilities and travel occasionally to support other Orbital offices or programs.

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
TWIC card.
Experience leading Asset Management, Asset Integrity, Mechanical Integrity (MI), or Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) programs.

Location Note:

This is an on-site and hybrid / remote position. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s location.

Salary Range

$93,000-157,000 annually (based on experience, qualifications, and location)

Benefits

A commitment to excellence and hard work will be rewarded with a competitive salary, career advancement opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid short-term disability coverage, company-paid maternity and bonding leave, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally.

Powered by People, Driven by Solutions

Since 1969, Orbital has been specializing in project development, project execution and asset management for the heavy industrial sectors and utilities. Our regional offices, hands-on mentality, and world-wide integrated teams provide an ability to leverage subject matter experts and industry best-practices wherever a project may lie geographically. Our focus steadfastly remains on finding and delivering the best solution, regardless of where that team sits across our organization. At Orbital, our power is our people.

jobs.title: GTM Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview

The GTM Enablement Program Manager owns readiness and performance for Fullbay's go-to-market teams — Marketing, BDR, and Sales. This role carries launch and change readiness for the GTM motion end to end, builds and maintains the talk tracks and plays those teams sell with, delivers sales skills programs to anyone at Fullbay who sells, and owns the content management system and governance that keep every enablement asset current, findable, and on-message. It also owns the Revenue Team onboarding foundation — the shared first weeks every customer-facing hire completes — in partnership with People Experience, while role-specific ramp stays with each audience owner. It is a blend of program management discipline and hands-on enablement craft: one week aligning Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps on what a launch asks reps to do differently, the next scoring call recordings to see whether they did it.

The Right Wrench for the Job

In a heavy-duty shop, the tech who earns trust isn't the one waiting for instructions on every bolt — it's the one who knows the job, makes smart calls at the bay, and speaks up when there's a better way to get the truck back on the road. That's the mindset this role is built for.
You'll own the GTM enablement portfolio end to end. Strategy and priority are set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement — how those outcomes get achieved is yours to run. You hold the manager-tier relationships in Sales, BDR, and Marketing directly, source your own scope from those stakeholders, and define success measures for every program you design. You're the right fit if you're an organized, self-directed professional who can hold a dozen moving parts without dropping one, who is as comfortable building a talk track as building a content taxonomy, and who brings ideas to the table rather than waiting to be handed them. We're looking for someone who proposes, decides, and executes with autonomy. If you want to build enablement that visibly changes how Fullbay's revenue teams sell, we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Discovery & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Holds direct working relationships with Sales, BDR, and Marketing leadership, Product Marketing, and Sales Operations to surface enablement needs, define problems, and align on what success looks like before work begins
Conducts discovery to understand audience, business context, and the behavior change a program is meant to drive
Translates ambiguous asks into clearly scoped programs with defined audiences, outcomes, and success measures
Partners with Product Marketing so that positioning, customer education, and rep enablement tell one story — built once, framed for each audience

Launch & Change Readiness

Owns launch and change readiness for the go-to-market motion — translating product releases, pricing and packaging changes, and process changes into what Marketing, BDR, and Sales need to know, say, and do differently
Builds the readiness plan for each launch, sequences enablement against the launch calendar, and confirms readiness before go-live
Sequences and prioritizes work across a portfolio of concurrent launches and programs, flagging collisions and dependencies early

Sales Skills, Talk Tracks & Plays

Builds and maintains talk tracks, plays, discovery guides, objection handling, and demo narratives grounded in Fullbay's sales methodology and GTM motion
Designs and delivers sales skills programs to anyone at Fullbay who sells, including Customer Success on expansion motions, with reinforcement materials and coaching guides that put the skill in managers' hands
Reviews call recordings against talk-track and methodology standards, and turns what the data shows into coaching content and program adjustments

Content Management & Governance

Owns the enablement content management system — intake, taxonomy, versioning, freshness, and retirement — across every enablement asset the function produces
Sets and enforces content governance standards so materials stay current, accurate, and easy to find for every customer-facing team
Runs the intake path for enablement requests and reports turnaround, asset freshness, and retirement rate

Revenue Team Onboarding

Owns the Revenue Team onboarding foundation — the shared curriculum every customer-facing hire completes — in partnership with People Experience, including systems provisioning and day-one access
Designs manager-led onboarding playbooks and sets the expectation that managers reinforce and deliver, with Enablement building and validating rather than carrying every session

Program & Project Management

Owns program execution end-to-end — building timelines, managing deliverables, coordinating stakeholders and SMEs, and driving initiatives to completion against deadlines
Maintains project plans and status, keeping initiatives, deliverables, and owners current and visible
Manages multiple time-sensitive programs simultaneously in a fast-changing environment, making independent decisions on how outcomes are achieved

Measurement & Reporting

Defines and owns the measures for GTM programs — talk-track adherence in call recordings, Salesforce hygiene and process compliance on enabled motions, launch readiness on time, content freshness and intake turnaround, and onboarding completion and time to productivity
Reports program influence on win rate, average deal size, cycle length, and attach rate of additional products on enabled plays, and uses that data to recommend what to continue, adjust, or retire

General

Uses Claude and other AI tools to accelerate drafting, program management, content development, and analysis, and participates in Fullbay's AI Builders Cohort
Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Work Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Education, or related field (Preferred)
3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales operations, or a closely related GTM function
Demonstrated experience owning programs or processes end-to-end — from definition and documentation through delivery, measurement, and handoff
Experience building sales-facing enablement content (talk tracks, plays, training materials, coaching guides, or similar) and delivering it live

Key Skills And Qualifications

Fluency across the full enablement lifecycle — discovery, strategic alignment, program management, content development and delivery, and measurement
Process design and documentation skills — able to turn an undefined workflow into a documented, tracked, governed system
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to hold multiple concurrent launches without losing the thread
Confident facilitator; able to deliver skills training to experienced sellers and produce the reinforcement that makes it stick
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build clear, polished content and explain ideas to technical and non-technical audiences alike
Self-directed professional judgment — makes decisions, proposes strategic ideas, and executes without needing to be told how
Comfortable holding manager-tier stakeholder relationships directly and operating with autonomy in a fast-moving function
Working knowledge of Salesforce and conversation intelligence tools; interest in and comfort with AI tools (Claude experience a plus)
Familiarity with the Sandler Selling methodology a plus, but not required

Physical Demands And Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS builds the custom silicon and platforms that power the world's largest AI and machine learning workloads. We are looking for an exceptional Principal Technical Program Manager to own the most strategic, org-defining programs behind AWS's AI accelerators — Trainium and Inferentia.

As a Principal TPM, you set the delivery strategy for programs that span silicon, hardware, software platforms, and ML frameworks, and you drive them across organizational and leadership boundaries. You bring order to the most ambiguous, highest-stakes problems — defining the mechanisms, the plan, and the critical path that many teams and multiple orgs execute against. You are a force multiplier: you raise the bar on how the entire organization plans and delivers, you influence roadmap and architectural direction through technical credibility, and you are the leader senior executives rely on for a definitive read on program health and the decisions that will make or break a launch. This is a rare opportunity to shape how purpose-built AI infrastructure is delivered at global scale.

Key job responsibilities

Own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of the organization's largest and most ambiguous cross-org programs — spanning silicon, hardware, software platforms, and ML frameworks.
Drive alignment and hold commitments across many teams, multiple orgs, and senior leaders; define the mechanisms that keep complex, multi-quarter programs transparent and on track.
Own the critical path across deep hardware/software dependencies; anticipate systemic risks and drive the trade-offs and decisions needed to protect strategic launches.
Influence roadmap, architecture, and investment decisions through technical depth and organization-wide perspective — not just track execution, but shape what gets built and in what order.
Serve as the definitive source of truth on program health for senior leadership; frame the narrative, the risks, and the decision asks that drive executive action.
Raise the bar on program management across the org — establishing and scaling mechanisms, mentoring TPMs, and elevating the delivery capability of the entire organization.

A day in the life

You lead a cross-org alignment with engineering and program leaders to resolve a systemic dependency that threatens two launches, driving to a clear decision and owner. Mid-morning you pressure-test an architectural trade-off with a PE, using your technical depth to shape the direction rather than just record it. In the afternoon you mentor a senior TPM through a hard risk review, then refine the mechanism the whole org will use for the next planning cycle. You close the day with a concise executive narrative — the state of the strategic programs, the systemic risks, and the two or three decisions leadership must make this week.

About The Team

We are the platform organization behind AWS's Trainium and Inferentia accelerators — the custom AI chips that deliver industry-leading price-performance for training and inference. Our programs sit at the intersection of silicon, hardware, and large-scale distributed software. We operate at the frontier of AI infrastructure, where the programs we deliver directly shape the cost and speed of AI for customers worldwide. We value ownership, structured thinking, technical depth, and a collaborative, high-trust culture where principal leaders multiply the impact of everyone around them.

10+ years of technical product or program management experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
8+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience working directly with engineering teams

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

Summary

Eligible for the Education Debt Reduction Program (EDRP) - a student loan payment reimbursement program. Must meet specific individual eligibility requirements in accordance with VHA policy and submit EDRP application within four months of appointment. Program Approval - award amount (up to $200 -000) and eligibility period (1-5 years) are determined by VHA Education Loan Repayment Services program office after complete review of the EDRP application. Former EDRP participants ineligible to apply.

Qualifications

To qualify for this position - applicants must meet all requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

Basic Requirements

United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy
English Language Proficiency
Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005 - Part II - Chapter 3 - section A - paragraph 3j
Education: Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA) - the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS) - or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed
The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
For the purpose of meeting this requirement - the term ""specialty area"" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills
Currently - APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology - counseling psychology - school psychology - or combinations of two or more of those areas
PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science
CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology - counseling psychology - clinical neuropsychology - and school psychology
There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist
therefore - an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment
Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA - there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology)
OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and - in addition - successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program
and - the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the re-specialization program - which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship
Psychologists who have successfully completed a re-specialization program as described above and who were employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs prior to the implementation of this standard are considered to have fully met the educational requirements of these qualification standards
OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution - with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature
Internship: Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement - provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern
OR VHA facilities that offered full-time - one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement
OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
(NOTE: Once board certified - the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program
If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript - the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program
Licensure
Hold a full - current - and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State - Territory - or Commonwealth of the United States - or the District of Columbia
May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria)

At least four years of experience as a professional psychologist - with at least one year equivalent to the GS-14 grade level
Demonstrated Knowledge - Skills - and Abilities

Skill in persuasion - negotiation - and motivation to negotiate multiple program policies
Skill in interpersonal relationships in dealing with employees and other managers using advanced consultation and problem solving skills
Skill in the application and analysis of measurement tools to systems issues
Ability to balance responsibilities in a complex environment and to work with great autonomy
ability to set priorities and delegate tasks - meet multiple deadlines - analyze complex organizational problems
and ability to develop and implement effective solutions for those problems
Ability to assess need for basic and complex services across multiple programmatic contexts
Ability to coordinate the efforts of multiple program elements across a complex system

jobs.title: Task Order Manager - Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

The Task Order Manager - Program Manager is a leadership position responsible for the overall management, execution, performance, and growth of multiple federal government task orders and contracts supporting the Department of Energy (DOE), National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal agencies. The individual must be capable of independently managing assigned programs, building strong customer relationships, leading and developing personnel, addressing performance challenges, and identifying opportunities to improve contract execution and expand the company's federal portfolio.

The Task Order Manager - Program Manager serves as a primary point of contact for assigned contracts, ensuring contractual requirements, deliverables, performance standards, and customer expectations are consistently met.

In addition to day-to-day contract management, the position plays an important role in identifying opportunities for organic growth, expanding existing contract scope, supporting recompete strategies, and collaborating with Business Development and Capture teams to pursue new task orders and related business opportunities.

Essential Functions

Task Order and Program Management

Provide overall leadership, management, and oversight of multiple federal government task orders, ensuring successful execution in accordance with contractual requirements, company policies, and customer expectations.
Serve as the primary management point of contact for assigned task orders, maintaining effective communication with Government Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), Contracting Officers (COs), federal program managers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders, consistent with contractual authority and communication protocols.
Manage all aspects of task order execution, including contract initiation, transition, staffing, operational performance, deliverable management, option period planning, and contract closeout.
Ensure compliance with contract Statements of Work (SOWs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), and other applicable contract requirements.
Monitor contract performance, identify potential risks or performance deficiencies, and implement timely corrective actions to maintain customer satisfaction and contract compliance.
Oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of contract-specific management plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), processes, and reporting requirements.
Ensure contract deliverables, monthly status reports, financial reports, and other required submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted within established deadlines.
Coordinate with Project Controls, Contracts, Finance, Human Resources, Security, and other corporate departments to ensure efficient and effective task order operations.
Manage subcontractor and teaming partner performance, ensuring responsibilities, deliverables, staffing commitments, and contractual obligations are fulfilled.
Facilitate regular internal program reviews and customer meetings to evaluate contract performance, identify challenges, establish priorities, and implement improvements.
Maintain awareness of contract periods of performance, funding limitations, labor categories, staffing requirements, and upcoming contract milestones.
Identify opportunities to standardize processes, improve operational efficiencies, reduce administrative burdens, and enhance overall program performance.
Escalate significant contractual, financial, staffing, or performance concerns to appropriate company leadership with recommended courses of action.

Financial Management and Contract Performance

Maintain overall responsibility for the financial health and performance of assigned task orders, including revenue, profitability, expenditures, funding utilization, and labor management.
Develop, monitor, and maintain task order budgets, spend plans, staffing projections, and financial forecasts in coordination with Project Controls and Finance.
Monitor contract ceilings, obligated funding, labor utilization, burn rates, and funding requirements to prevent funding shortfalls, unauthorized expenditures, or interruptions in contract performance.
Review financial reports and contract performance metrics to identify trends, potential risks, and opportunities to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
Coordinate with Project Controls to ensure timely and accurate preparation, review, and submission of invoices, travel expenses, subcontractor costs, and other financial documentation.
Evaluate labor category assignments, staffing allocations, and resource utilization to ensure alignment with contract requirements and approved budgets.
Support contract modifications, funding requests, option period planning, and adjustments to staffing or contract scope.
Monitor actual expenditures against planned budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
Work with company leadership to establish and monitor financial performance objectives for assigned contracts.
Ensure contract management practices support company financial goals while maintaining compliance with applicable federal contracting requirements.

Personnel Management, Hiring, and Staffing

Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, hiring, onboarding, employee development, and retention for personnel assigned to managed task orders.
Evaluate current and projected staffing requirements to ensure appropriate personnel and resources are available to meet contract obligations.
Coordinate with Human Resources and Recruiting to develop position descriptions, identify qualified candidates, conduct interviews, and support hiring decisions.
Manage staffing transitions, employee replacements, vacancies, and surge requirements while minimizing disruptions to contract performance.
Provide leadership, direction, and support to assigned employees, ensuring personnel understand their responsibilities, performance expectations, and customer requirements.
Conduct employee performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, recognize outstanding performance, and identify professional development opportunities.
Address employee performance, attendance, conduct, and workplace concerns in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.
Promote employee engagement, professional growth, accountability, collaboration, and retention across assigned programs.
Maintain regular communication with employees and customer representatives to assess workload, staffing effectiveness, morale, and potential areas of concern.
Identify and develop employees capable of assuming additional responsibilities or leadership roles within existing and future contracts.
Coordinate employee compensation recommendations, promotions, retention strategies, and personnel actions with appropriate company leadership and Human Resources.
Ensure employees comply with company policies, contractual requirements, security procedures, timekeeping standards, and customer-specific workplace expectations.

Contract Growth, Business Development, and Capture Support

Identify and pursue opportunities for organic growth within assigned contracts, including additional staffing requirements, expanded scopes of work, new technical capabilities, and emerging customer needs.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with existing federal customers to strengthen customer satisfaction, increase contract retention, and position the company for future opportunities.
Collaborate with the Vice President, Business Development, Capture, and Proposal Development teams to identify and evaluate opportunities for new task orders, contract extensions, recompetes, and related federal work.
Monitor customer priorities, mission requirements, procurement forecasts, and upcoming contract opportunities to identify potential business growth.
Support the development of capture strategies by providing contract performance information, customer insights, staffing strategies, technical approaches, and operational lessons learned.
Contribute to the preparation and review of technical proposals, management approaches, staffing plans, transition plans, past performance narratives, and other proposal materials.
Assist with pricing strategies and labor category development by providing staffing projections, operational requirements, and knowledge of existing contract performance.
Participate in customer meetings, industry engagements, and teaming discussions to support business development and strategic positioning.
Identify potential teaming partners, subcontractors, and specialized resources that could strengthen existing contract execution or support new business opportunities.
Support contract recompete planning by identifying incumbent strengths, performance accomplishments, staffing considerations, and potential competitive risks.
Work with company leadership to establish realistic growth objectives for assigned programs and actively contribute to achieving those objectives.
Ensure business development and customer engagement activities are conducted in accordance with federal procurement integrity requirements and applicable organizational policies.

Strategic Leadership, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

Provide strategic and operational input to the Vice President, Senior Vice President, and executive leadership regarding contract performance, staffing requirements, financial risks, customer priorities, and business growth opportunities.
Develop and implement management strategies that support successful task order execution, employee performance, customer satisfaction, and organizational growth.
Identify and recommend improvements to internal processes, contract management procedures, reporting requirements, and resource allocation.
Ensure assigned contracts operate in accordance with applicable Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Department of Energy Acquisition Regulation (DEAR), contractual requirements, security procedures, and company policies.
Support the implementation and maintenance of company quality management standards, internal controls, and applicable ISO 9001 and CMMI processes.
Participate in internal program reviews, management assessments, compliance reviews, and audits as required.
Promote effective collaboration between Program Management, Project Controls, Contracts, Finance, Human Resources, Business Development, and other corporate departments.
Provide mentorship and guidance to junior program managers, task order leads, and other personnel as appropriate.
Contribute to corporate strategic planning initiatives by identifying operational improvements, emerging customer requirements, potential contract risks, and opportunities for continued growth.
Foster a culture of accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and exceptional customer service.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related field required.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in federal government contracting, program management, contract operations, or related fields.
At least 5 years of demonstrated experience managing federal contracts, task orders, programs, or multiple concurrent projects.
Demonstrated ability to manage contract budgets, labor utilization, financial forecasts, funding requirements, and overall contract profitability.
Experience managing employees, recruiting and hiring personnel, conducting performance evaluations, and addressing workforce challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven experience overseeing multiple federal task orders with responsibility for contract execution, staffing, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.
Demonstrated experience managing government contracts under GSA Multiple Award Schedules, Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs), Indefinite Delivery/

jobs.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager, Fulfilled by Amazon
jobs.description:
Description

What if you could architect the programs that propel Amazon's fulfillment business to $1 trillion? We're building a newly created team with that singular mission — and we need a Technical Program Manager who can drive it.

This newly formed team sits at the intersection of Amazon's most ambitious growth vectors for Fulfilled by Amazon (FBA). We're targeting the segments with maximum untapped potential: High ASP products, Non-sort inventory, Multi-packs, and other under-penetrated categories that collectively represent hundreds of billions in addressable market. Our charter is to build the tech, mechanisms, and cross-functional execution muscle that unlocks step-function growth across these segments — spanning hundreds of fulfillment centers worldwide and impacting hundreds of billions in annual GMS.

This isn’t “TPM as status-tracker.” This is a TPM as the chief orchestrator of large-scale, cross-functional programs that reshape Fulfilled by Amazon. We’re looking for a force multiplier who uses AI as a superpower to accelerate program delivery, automate decision-making, and drive execution at a pace that matches our ambition. Someone who thinks in systems, communicates with surgical precision, builds mechanisms that scale globally, and delivers programs that move atoms at the speed of bits.

Key job responsibilities

Drive Large Cross-Functional Programs

Lead end-to-end program execution for High ASP, Non-sort, and Multi-pack initiatives that expand FBA’s addressable market to $1T
Define and drive cross-functional program roadmaps spanning engineering, science, operations, and business teams to deliver category-specialized fulfillment solutions
Build and own program mechanisms (business reviews, escalation paths, dependency tracking) that ensure on-time delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives across segments with maximum growth potential
Identify and resolve cross-organizational dependencies, remove blockers, and drive alignment across SVP organizations to accelerate speed-to-market for new fulfillment capabilities

AI-First Program Execution

Deploy generative AI and agentic systems to automate program tracking, risk identification, stakeholder communication, and decision-making — AI is not a feature, it’s your operating system
Use AI to 10x program velocity: LLM-powered status synthesis, automated dependency mapping, AI-generated risk assessments, and generative AI for mechanism design and documentation

Cross-Geography, Cross-Organization Impact

Drive program execution across WW geographies (US, EU, CA, IN, JP), each with unique regulatory, operational, and market constraints requiring tailored approaches
Partner directly with senior leaders across multiple SVP organizations
Coordinate cross-functional execution for growth categories to unlock category-specialized fulfillment at global scale

The Defect Prevention and Reconciliation (DP&R) organization builds innovative technical products that recognize, reconcile, and prevent exceptions within Amazon’s fulfillment supply chain. We are building a future where we capture, analyze, and explain every inventory defect across all stages of the supply chain (i.e. inbound, distribution, storage, fulfillment, returns). The Support Operations Tools and Automation team, within DP&R, owns the system technology, and tools used by the DP&R Support Operations to onboard, investigate and audit WW Seller and Vendor contacts to Amazon.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS builds the custom silicon and platforms that power the world's largest AI and machine learning workloads. We are looking for an exceptional Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the most complex, cross-organizational programs behind AWS's AI accelerators — Trainium and Inferentia.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery of ambiguous, high-stakes programs that span silicon, hardware, software platforms, and ML frameworks. You will bring structure to ambiguity, drive alignment across many teams, surface and resolve the critical path, and hold a diverse set of stakeholders accountable to commitments. You will be the connective tissue that turns a portfolio of independent efforts into a coherent, on-time delivery — and the trusted voice leadership relies on for a clear-eyed view of status, risk, and the decisions that matter. This is a rare opportunity to shape how purpose-built AI infrastructure gets built and shipped at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Own the planning and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-functional programs spanning silicon, hardware, software platforms, and ML frameworks — defining scope, milestones, dependencies, and the critical path.
Drive alignment across many teams and leaders; establish mechanisms (planning, status, risk reviews) that keep a complex program moving and transparent.
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks; drive mitigations and force clarity on trade-offs before they become launch-blocking.
Translate ambiguous, high-level goals into concrete plans with clear owners, dates, and success criteria.
Communicate crisp status, risks, and decision asks to senior leadership; be the single source of truth for program health.
Raise the bar on program management practices and mechanisms across the org, driving continuous improvement in how the team plans and executes.

A day in the life

You start the day scanning program dashboards and updating the critical path from a partner team. You run a cross-team sync to unblock a dependency between the hardware and software platform teams, then spend mid-morning pressure-testing a launch plan and pinning down owners and dates for the open risks. In the afternoon you drive a risk review, update the program's status narrative, and align stakeholders on a scope trade-off that protects the launch date. You close the day sending a crisp leadership update — where the program stands, the top risks, and the two decisions you need this week. Throughout, you are converting ambiguity into a clear, shared plan and holding the whole program accountable to it.

About The Team

We are the platform organization behind AWS's Trainium and Inferentia accelerators — the custom AI chips that deliver industry-leading price-performance for training and inference. Our programs sit at the intersection of silicon, hardware, and large-scale distributed software. We operate at the frontier of AI infrastructure, where the programs we deliver directly shape the cost and speed of AI for customers worldwide. We value ownership, structured thinking, operational rigor, and a collaborative, high-trust culture where program managers and engineers succeed together.

8+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM is seeking a talented and experienced Mining Program Manager
for our growing Mining team in Lima, Peru or Mexico.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Manage multi-disciplined engineering and project delivery teams, including a hybrid blend of in-person and remote team members.
Demonstrate creativity, foresight and mature judgment in anticipating and solving both routine and unusual project delivery, technical and client challenges, determining technical objectives and requirements, organizing programs and projects.
Manage and monitor contractual obligations for engineering projects of various sizes and complexities.
Prepare project and engineering work plans, budgets, schedules for studies, detailed design, and construction support.
Monitor project cost, schedule, and quality performance, and take corrective action as necessary.
Lead project meetings, ensure timely delivery of minutes, and drive meeting efficiency and effective outcomes.
Supervise discipline resources and/or assist in the preparation of deliverables and products such as presentation materials, calculations, drawings, specifications, and cost estimates related to mining and industrial site infrastructure, port infrastructure, materials handling systems, process residue waste management and mechanical services.
Supervise the production of project reports and the project control functions.
Proactively manage scope and change management according to company standards and project requirements.
Supervise preparation of project gating deliverables using sound project development logic and with written expression that is cohesive, clear, and concise on subject matters varying from simple to very complex.
Assume mentoring and training roles and identify high potential employees to management.
Work with business line and regional leaders to ensure compliance with internal proposal and project approval requirements.
Work with clients to provide long-term solutions.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant industry experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
Demonstrated experience in pursuing and winning opportunities in Peru with a strong reputation in the LATAM mining market.
English/Spanish Fluency

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline.
20+ years of progressive experience in the mining field with an emphasis on materials handling, mine waste management, mining infrastructure and project execution in Peru & LATAM.
Program Manager responsibility for at least three (3) prefeasibility or feasibility studies with capital value +$100M.
Project experience in both open pit and underground mining sectors is an advantage.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

This position does not offer relocation assistance now or in the future
This position does not offer sponsorship assistance now or in the future

jobs.description:
Job Title

Asset Management Program Manager - Manufacturing & Specialty Chemicals

Location:

Chicago, IL / St. Louis, MO

FLSA Classification

Exempt

Job Description

As an Asset Management Program Manager / Senior Project Manager
within Orbital’s Asset Integrity business unit, you will lead multi-year, multi-site inspection and asset management programs for industrial clients, with an emphasis on Manufacturing & Specialty Chemicals. You will own program execution, client coordination, and continuous improvement while managing the scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety of assigned inspection projects and asset management activities. You will work alongside engineering teams to share inspection findings, coordinate interfaces, and support client planning.

The position is primarily remote-based, with a mix of in-office, periodic visits to client facilities, and occasional travel to support the program.

Essential Functions

Lead Inspection & Asset Management Programs

Develop and lead inspection and asset management programs for structural and other infrastructure assets across multiple facilities.
Serve as the primary client contact for assigned programs, aligning execution with asset lifecycle goals, risk tolerance, and operational priorities.
Guide inspection strategies, risk-based prioritization, and program improvements; provide asset condition information to support client- and engineering-led repair and capital planning.
Hire, supervise, and develop inspection and asset management staff; establish clear goals, provide guidance, and conduct performance reviews for direct reports.

Deliver Consistent Program Execution

Manage concurrent inspection projects and asset management activities, maintaining accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety.
Plan and coordinate inspectors, program staff, and inspection subcontractors; align inspection activities with engineering interfaces without directing engineering or design work.
Review inspection reports and program deliverables for completeness, consistency, and alignment with requirements; coordinate engineering technical reviews when needed.
Lead inspection quality reviews and program status meetings and contribute inspection findings and program context to engineering-led technical discussions.

Strengthen Quality & Continuous Improvement

Improve inspection procedures, reporting standards, and program workflows in collaboration with responsible technical teams; support engineering-defined inspection requirements without owning engineering or design standards.
Ensure assigned inspection and asset management activities follow Orbital’s Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable client, regulatory, and industry requirements.
Promote consistent, repeatable, and defensible inspection and asset condition data across facilities and programs.

Build Long-Term Client Partnerships

Develop and strengthen long-term client relationships.
Collaborate with Orbital leadership and Strategic Partners on program renewals, expansions, and new asset management opportunities.
Develop scopes, execution strategies, schedules, and cost estimates for inspection and asset management proposals; provide supporting program information for engineering-led proposals.

Other Duties

Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice .

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Structural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university or a minimum of 10 years of directly relevant Asset Management or Project Management experience
Minimum of 10 years of experience, preferably within a consulting engineering or asset integrity environment
Experience supporting asset-intensive industries such as power generation, oil and gas, refining, chemical processing, manufacturing, steel, mining, or materials processing.
A strong understanding of inspection planning, risk-based prioritization, asset lifecycle decision-making, and program governance.
Proficiency with project management tools, project controls, and scheduling software such as Microsoft Project.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with operations, maintenance, engineering, and management personnel.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and collaborate in a consulting environment.
Ability to commute to local client facilities and travel occasionally to support other Orbital offices or programs.

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
TWIC card.

The Program Manager - Fire Safety and Compliance is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing comprehensive fire safety programs within the Medical University of South Carolina. The Program Manager will oversee fire safety inspections, manage fire safety teams, and coordinate fire prevention and response activities to maintain a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors. The role requires working in various environments, including academic facilities, research laboratories, clinical areas, administrative offices, and other healthcare settings. Some travel may be required to off-site clinics and facilities. The employee must be available for on-call duty and to respond to fire emergencies outside of regular working hours.
