jobs.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Payscale: $82,158.00 -$125,000.00

Bonus:
This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits:
Full-time:
We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.

Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

This role exists to answer a specific question for clients spending money on paid search: what are we buying, what is it returning, and where should the budget move next. You will own the numbers and the analysis behind those answers, from pulling the raw platform data through to the slide or memo a board or a marketing director reads before signing off the next quarter.
The work is paid-click demand, but the analysis rarely stops at the bid. You will look at search terms, competitive auctions, landing page behavior, margin by product line and the relationship between paid and organic, then say plainly which part of the spend earns its place. You will work alongside principals who scoped the mandate and will deliver it with you.

What You Will Do
Build and maintain the reporting that clients use to judge paid search performance, covering spend, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend and the margin behind each conversion.
Run search term, auction and competitor analysis, then write the short memo that says what should change and why.
Take the platform exports and internal sales data and turn them into one reconciled view that a finance or marketing lead can trust.
Sit in client working sessions to walk through the numbers, answer questions on the spot and note where assumptions need testing.
Support the principal in building budget scenarios, testing them against historical performance before they reach a board or committee.
Document the measurement logic behind each recommendation so the client can carry it forward after the engagement ends.

What We Need From You
Comfort with paid search platforms and the data they produce, including campaign structures, bidding and attribution settings.
Strong spreadsheet work: modeling, cleaning messy exports, and building a view someone else can follow without a call.
The ability to write clearly in English and in Arabic, since client documents and working sessions can move between both.
Judgment about which finding matters and which does not, and the discipline to say so rather than present everything you found.
Experience in a client-facing setting, whether in-house, at an agency, or in a consulting or advisory context.
Willingness to work in Riyadh on a hybrid basis, with time in the office and time with clients.

What Success Looks Like
Within the first few months, the client stops asking for the monthly report because they already know what is in it and what it means.
Budget recommendations you built survive the principal's review and the client's finance team without rework.
Someone on the client side can explain your measurement logic back to you, correctly, without your help.
The principal can hand you a messy data set and a question on a Monday and trust the answer by Thursday.

Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. We take on corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. The principals who scope a mandate are the ones who deliver it, and engagements often continue past the recommendation while decisions get implemented.
People who settle in here tend to be writers first and analysts second. They like a number they can defend, they are comfortable asking a client to explain a term they use loosely, and they would rather form a view and be held to it than hand over four options and a request for guidance. The hybrid arrangement puts you in Riyadh with the team and in front of clients, and the work tends to hold its shape long enough for you to see whether it was right.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video
jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video (PV) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own Operational Excellence and Development Efficiency across the business. Reporting directly to the Director of READI, this is a strategic, single-threaded leadership role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and can set direction where the problem itself is not yet defined.

As a Principal TPM, you will operate across VP organizations, exercising broad strategic influence over how Prime Video plans, measures, and improves the operational health of its services and the productivity of its engineers. You will own high-visibility operating mechanisms — most notably the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review — and set the overall strategy, goals, and initiatives for Operational Excellence across PV. You will manage significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives, remediate endemic problems, and force-multiply your impact through the mechanisms and standards you create. This is a role for someone who is regularly escalated to, rather than one who escalates.

Key job responsibilities

Operational Excellence Strategy & Goals

Define and own the multi-year strategy, annual goals, and initiative portfolio for Operational Excellence across Prime Video, aligning teams and organizations toward a simple, coherent approach.

Establish the operational metrics, standards, and paved-road practices that define what “good” looks like for PV services — covering availability, resilience, incident management, and operational readiness.

Set and track org-level operational goals planning, translating leadership priorities into measurable outcomes and holding teams accountable to them.

Remediate critical and endemic operational problems by identifying systemic root causes and driving durable, cross-org fixes rather than point solutions.

High-Visibility Mechanisms (PV Quarterly Operations Review)

Own the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review end-to-end — its agenda, data, narrative, and follow-through — as the authoritative forum where PV leadership inspects operational health and commits to improvements.

Design, run, and continuously improve the portfolio of operating mechanisms (weekly/monthly business and ops reviews, metrics dashboards, and governance cadences) that create predictable inspection and drive action.

Curate crisp, accurate, and timely written narratives and data for senior leaders (up to and including VPs and S-Team-facing readouts), ensuring decisions are well-informed and action items are tracked to closure.

Create the connective tissue between mechanisms so that signals surfaced in one forum reliably drive prioritization, resourcing, and roadmap decisions across PV.

Development Efficiency

Own the strategy for improving developer productivity and delivery velocity across PV — reducing friction in the software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations.

Define and instrument developer efficiency metrics (e.g., build and deployment health, cycle time, change failure rate, time-to-recover) and use them to target the highest-leverage investments.

Drive adoption of paved-road tooling, standards, and best practices that simplify how PV teams build and operate, eliminating undifferentiated heavy lifting and unnecessary process.

Partner with builder-tools and infrastructure teams to unblock innovation and increase the speed and safety of delivery at scale.

Cross-Org Influence & Force Multiplication

Operate across VP organizations with broad strategic influence, building consensus, securing commitments, and negotiating positive outcomes among senior engineering and product leaders.

Drive clarity in ambiguity — frame problems that are not yet defined, align stakeholders on the path forward, and deliver with complete independence.

Force-multiply through the mechanisms, standards, and structures you create, raising the operational bar across teams without being in the critical path of every decision.

Actively develop the TPM community at PV — mentoring senior TPMs, contributing to promotion assessments, and elevating program-management craft across the organization.

A day in the life

No two days look the same, but the through-line is mechanism ownership and strategic influence. You might begin the morning diving deep into operational metrics ahead of the Quarterly Operations Review — pressure-testing the data, sharpening the narrative, and pre-aligning VP-org leaders on the decisions that need to be made. Midday, you facilitate a working session with engineering directors to unblock a cross-org resilience initiative, making the trade-off calls between business opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability.

In the afternoon, you shift to development efficiency — reviewing delivery-velocity trends, identifying the systemic bottlenecks slowing teams down, and shaping the paved-road investments that will remove them. Throughout, you are the person leaders are escalated to when operational health is at risk, and the owner who ensures every commitment coming out of a mechanism is tracked to closure. Your success is measured not by the work you personally execute, but by the durable systems, standards, and mechanisms you leave behind.

About The Team

READI is a central function in Prime Video that drives strategy, tooling, and programs for Scale Readiness, Operational Excellence, Resilience & Observability, and Development Efficiency. READI’s value as a central team relies heavily on outward-facing influence: its strategy, decisions, and guidance are amplified across all of PV. Prime Video operates a global, high-scale streaming service, spending hundreds of millions in infrastructure and allocating hundreds of engineers to operational load each year — a surface area where disciplined operational rigor and improved development efficiency translate directly into customer experience, cost, and speed of innovation.

Today, ownership of PV-wide Operational Excellence strategy and its supporting mechanisms is distributed, creating diffusion of responsibility and inconsistent standards across teams. This role exists to close that gap: to be the single-threaded owner who defines what operational excellence means for PV, instruments it, runs the mechanisms that inspect it, and drives the initiatives that continuously raise the bar.

Basic Qualifications

12+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
10+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Description

The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Executive Briefing Program is seeking an experienced Briefing Program Manager to plan and deliver high-value executive briefings for customers at one of our Executive Briefing Centers. As a Briefing Program Manager, you are responsible for the overall success of onsite executive briefings. This includes managing planning timelines, stakeholder expectations and communications, executive engagement, and the successful execution of each briefing. You will work with internal sales stakeholders to provide consultation on the design of briefing engagements, working backwards from the customer's business objectives to develop bespoke agendas and experiences that solve specific customer challenges and advance adoption of AWS services. You will work closely with supporting briefing team members to plan and execute engagements that deepen customer relationships and accelerate cloud adoption. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who builds partnerships easily, has strong project management and analytical skills, and can manage multiple briefings at once. They communicate effectively with executive stakeholders and deliver independently on both tactical and program initiatives, while seeking direction on complex or ambiguous engagements. They are organized, comfortable applying established processes and guidelines, collaborative, and able to work backwards from the customer to make data-informed decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of executive briefings at a single Executive Briefing Center, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the briefing lifecycle.
Work backwards from the customer's business objectives to develop briefing agendas and facilitate experiences that connect AWS executives, technical subject matter experts, and customers in outcome-based discussions.
Partner with account teams and internal stakeholders to provide consultation during the briefing planning process and set clear expectations with internal and external stakeholders.
Build and maintain relationships with account teams, speakers, and vendors to deliver a streamlined, high-quality experience.
Apply established playbooks and timelines, and recommend improvements to existing processes and tools based on customer feedback and delivery experience.
Use data and metrics to track delivery, measure briefing effectiveness, and surface insights that may inform broader program improvements.
Manage briefing meetings including kick-offs, planning calls, and post-briefing debriefs.
Begin to mentor briefing coordinators and newer team members by sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel: less than 10% of time.

A day in the life

Your days will be spent hosting customers at our center, meeting with account teams to plan and craft customer engagements, and sourcing the right AWS speakers to help customers achieve their business objectives. About 25 to 50 percent of the work week is spent hosting customers, while the remainder is spent planning future engagements and working with your team to improve delivery and the customer experience.

Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

Congratulations on taking control of your career! We’re pleased you’re exploring opportunities to evolve and adapt your professional life. MITRE's diversity of sponsor missions, research areas, and cross-corporate capabilities translates into hundreds of meaningful projects at any given time. We invite you to discover how your unique combination of strengths and experiences can benefit our work program in new ways.

MITRE Technology and Engineering is seeking a Biosafety and Biosecurity Analyst with experience or demonstrated knowledge in biosafety and biosecurity risk assessments, infectious disease research, and supporting research oversight committees (e.g., institutional review boards, institutional animal care and use committees, biosafety committees, and/or institutional review entities). The analyst will support multidisciplinary scientific and technical reviews of life sciences research with potential biosafety, biosecurity, public health, and national security implications.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Scientific and Technical Reviews: Contribute to multidisciplinary scientific and technical reviews of life sciences research with potential biosafety, biosecurity, public health, or national security implications. Evaluate and synthesize scientific and technical information to identify key considerations, information gaps, and areas requiring additional analysis. Develop technical summaries, background materials, briefing materials, assessments, recommendations, and other decision-support products in collaboration with senior staff and subject matter experts. Clearly communicate complex scientific, risk, and policy information to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Coordinate and Support Review Meetings: Coordinate scientific and technical review activities from initial intake through review, documentation, resolution, and follow-up. Plan and execute review meetings, including coordinating participants and technical expertise, preparing materials, managing logistics, documenting deliberations and outcomes, and tracking follow-up actions. Engage with review participants to obtain necessary information, resolve questions, and facilitate timely completion of review activities. Maintain accurate records, status information, metrics, and supporting documentation.
Develop and Apply Expertise: Contribute expertise across a broader portfolio of work involving biological risk, biodefense, health security, emerging biotechnology, and related national security challenges. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to address complex scientific, technical, and policy problems. Continue to build and develop expertise to meet critical sponsor challenges.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Academic background or professional experience in infectious disease, microbiology, virology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, public health, biosafety, biosecurity, or related discipline.
Knowledge of infectious disease and the scientific principles relevant to biological research.
Knowledge of biosafety and biosecurity principles and their application to life sciences research.
Knowledge of U.S. policies, frameworks, or guidance related to dangerous gain of function research, biosafety, and biosecurity.
Familiarity with risk assessment or risk management approaches associated with life sciences research and emerging biotechnologies.
Ability to analyze and synthesize complex scientific and technical information and communicate key findings accurately.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop clear technical summaries, briefing materials, and other written products.
Strong organization skills and attention to detail, with the ability to coordinate multiple activities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet deadlines.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with scientific and technical subject matter experts.
Ability to exercise sound judgement and discretion when working with sensitive scientific and technical information.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week on-site

Preferred Qualifications:

Professional experience related to biosafety, biosecurity, biological risk assessment, biodefense, or health security.
Experience evaluating scientific literature or research involving infectious agents, host-pathogen interactions, pathogenicity, transmissibility, virulence, and other characteristics relevant to biological risk.
Experience supporting scientific or technical reviews, advisory groups, working groups, or other multidisciplinary technical activities.
Experience supporting or participating in research compliance committees such as institutional biosafety committees, institutional review entities, institutional animal care and use committees, or institutional review boards.
Demonstrated ability to develop new subject matter expertise quickly and apply that knowledge across multiple projects or problem areas.

None

Top Secret/SCI

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale

Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)

Job Description

As an Asset Management Program Manager / Senior Project Manager
within Orbital’s Asset Integrity business unit, you will lead multi-year, multi-site inspection and asset management programs for industrial clients, with an emphasis on Power Generation. You will own program execution, client coordination, and continuous improvement while managing the scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety of assigned inspection projects and asset management activities. You will work alongside engineering teams to share inspection findings, coordinate interfaces, and support client planning.

The position is primarily remote-based, with a mix of in-office, periodic visits to client facilities, and occasional travel to support the program.

Essential Functions

Lead Inspection & Asset Management Programs

Develop and lead inspection and asset management programs for structural and other infrastructure assets across multiple facilities.
Serve as the primary client contact for assigned programs, aligning execution with asset lifecycle goals, risk tolerance, and operational priorities.
Guide inspection strategies, risk-based prioritization, and program improvements; provide asset condition information to support client- and engineering-led repair and capital planning.
Hire, supervise, and develop inspection and asset management staff; establish clear goals, provide guidance, and conduct performance reviews for direct reports.

Deliver Consistent Program Execution

Plan and coordinate inspectors, program staff, and inspection subcontractors; align inspection activities with engineering interfaces without directing engineering or design work.

Strengthen Quality & Continuous Improvement

Ensure assigned inspection and asset management activities follow Orbital’s Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable client, regulatory, and industry requirements.
Promote consistent, repeatable, and defensible inspection and asset condition data across facilities and programs.

Build Long-Term Client Partnerships

Develop and strengthen long-term client relationships.
Collaborate with Orbital leadership and Strategic Partners on program renewals, expansions, and new asset management opportunities.
Develop scopes, execution strategies, schedules, and cost estimates for inspection and asset management proposals; provide supporting program information for engineering-led proposals.

new_jobs.title: GTM Enablement Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview

The GTM Enablement Program Manager owns readiness and performance for Fullbay's go-to-market teams — Marketing, BDR, and Sales. This role carries launch and change readiness for the GTM motion end to end, builds and maintains the talk tracks and plays those teams sell with, delivers sales skills programs to anyone at Fullbay who sells, and owns the content management system and governance that keep every enablement asset current, findable, and on-message. It also owns the Revenue Team onboarding foundation — the shared first weeks every customer-facing hire completes — in partnership with People Experience, while role-specific ramp stays with each audience owner. It is a blend of program management discipline and hands-on enablement craft: one week aligning Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps on what a launch asks reps to do differently, the next scoring call recordings to see whether they did it.

The Right Wrench for the Job

In a heavy-duty shop, the tech who earns trust isn't the one waiting for instructions on every bolt — it's the one who knows the job, makes smart calls at the bay, and speaks up when there's a better way to get the truck back on the road. That's the mindset this role is built for.
You'll own the GTM enablement portfolio end to end. Strategy and priority are set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement — how those outcomes get achieved is yours to run. You hold the manager-tier relationships in Sales, BDR, and Marketing directly, source your own scope from those stakeholders, and define success measures for every program you design. You're the right fit if you're an organized, self-directed professional who can hold a dozen moving parts without dropping one, who is as comfortable building a talk track as building a content taxonomy, and who brings ideas to the table rather than waiting to be handed them. We're looking for someone who proposes, decides, and executes with autonomy. If you want to build enablement that visibly changes how Fullbay's revenue teams sell, we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Discovery & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Holds direct working relationships with Sales, BDR, and Marketing leadership, Product Marketing, and Sales Operations to surface enablement needs, define problems, and align on what success looks like before work begins
Conducts discovery to understand audience, business context, and the behavior change a program is meant to drive
Translates ambiguous asks into clearly scoped programs with defined audiences, outcomes, and success measures
Partners with Product Marketing so that positioning, customer education, and rep enablement tell one story — built once, framed for each audience

Launch & Change Readiness

Owns launch and change readiness for the go-to-market motion — translating product releases, pricing and packaging changes, and process changes into what Marketing, BDR, and Sales need to know, say, and do differently
Builds the readiness plan for each launch, sequences enablement against the launch calendar, and confirms readiness before go-live
Sequences and prioritizes work across a portfolio of concurrent launches and programs, flagging collisions and dependencies early

Sales Skills, Talk Tracks & Plays

Builds and maintains talk tracks, plays, discovery guides, objection handling, and demo narratives grounded in Fullbay's sales methodology and GTM motion
Designs and delivers sales skills programs to anyone at Fullbay who sells, including Customer Success on expansion motions, with reinforcement materials and coaching guides that put the skill in managers' hands
Reviews call recordings against talk-track and methodology standards, and turns what the data shows into coaching content and program adjustments

Content Management & Governance

Owns the enablement content management system — intake, taxonomy, versioning, freshness, and retirement — across every enablement asset the function produces
Sets and enforces content governance standards so materials stay current, accurate, and easy to find for every customer-facing team
Runs the intake path for enablement requests and reports turnaround, asset freshness, and retirement rate

Revenue Team Onboarding

Owns the Revenue Team onboarding foundation — the shared curriculum every customer-facing hire completes — in partnership with People Experience, including systems provisioning and day-one access
Designs manager-led onboarding playbooks and sets the expectation that managers reinforce and deliver, with Enablement building and validating rather than carrying every session

Program & Project Management

Owns program execution end-to-end — building timelines, managing deliverables, coordinating stakeholders and SMEs, and driving initiatives to completion against deadlines
Maintains project plans and status, keeping initiatives, deliverables, and owners current and visible
Manages multiple time-sensitive programs simultaneously in a fast-changing environment, making independent decisions on how outcomes are achieved

Measurement & Reporting

Defines and owns the measures for GTM programs — talk-track adherence in call recordings, Salesforce hygiene and process compliance on enabled motions, launch readiness on time, content freshness and intake turnaround, and onboarding completion and time to productivity
Reports program influence on win rate, average deal size, cycle length, and attach rate of additional products on enabled plays, and uses that data to recommend what to continue, adjust, or retire

General

Uses Claude and other AI tools to accelerate drafting, program management, content development, and analysis, and participates in Fullbay's AI Builders Cohort
Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Work Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Education, or related field (Preferred)
3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales operations, or a closely related GTM function
Demonstrated experience owning programs or processes end-to-end — from definition and documentation through delivery, measurement, and handoff
Experience building sales-facing enablement content (talk tracks, plays, training materials, coaching guides, or similar) and delivering it live

Key Skills And Qualifications

Fluency across the full enablement lifecycle — discovery, strategic alignment, program management, content development and delivery, and measurement
Process design and documentation skills — able to turn an undefined workflow into a documented, tracked, governed system
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to hold multiple concurrent launches without losing the thread
Confident facilitator; able to deliver skills training to experienced sellers and produce the reinforcement that makes it stick
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build clear, polished content and explain ideas to technical and non-technical audiences alike
Self-directed professional judgment — makes decisions, proposes strategic ideas, and executes without needing to be told how
Comfortable holding manager-tier stakeholder relationships directly and operating with autonomy in a fast-moving function
Working knowledge of Salesforce and conversation intelligence tools; interest in and comfort with AI tools (Claude experience a plus)
Familiarity with the Sandler Selling methodology a plus, but not required

Physical Demands And Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

new_jobs.title: Senior Psychologist Program Manager - Outpatient Mental Health Section
new_jobs.description:
Summary

Eligible for the Education Debt Reduction Program (EDRP) - a student loan payment reimbursement program. Must meet specific individual eligibility requirements in accordance with VHA policy and submit EDRP application within four months of appointment. Program Approval - award amount (up to $200 -000) and eligibility period (1-5 years) are determined by VHA Education Loan Repayment Services program office after complete review of the EDRP application. Former EDRP participants ineligible to apply.

Qualifications

To qualify for this position - applicants must meet all requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

Basic Requirements

United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy
English Language Proficiency
Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005 - Part II - Chapter 3 - section A - paragraph 3j
Education: Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA) - the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS) - or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed
The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
For the purpose of meeting this requirement - the term ""specialty area"" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills
Currently - APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology - counseling psychology - school psychology - or combinations of two or more of those areas
PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science
CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology - counseling psychology - clinical neuropsychology - and school psychology
There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist
therefore - an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment
Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA - there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology)
OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and - in addition - successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program
and - the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the re-specialization program - which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship
Psychologists who have successfully completed a re-specialization program as described above and who were employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs prior to the implementation of this standard are considered to have fully met the educational requirements of these qualification standards
OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution - with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature
Internship: Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement - provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern
OR VHA facilities that offered full-time - one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement
OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed
(NOTE: Once board certified - the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program
If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript - the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program
Licensure
Hold a full - current - and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State - Territory - or Commonwealth of the United States - or the District of Columbia
May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria)
Grade Determinations: Senior Psychologist Program Manager - GS-15 Experience
At least four years of experience as a professional psychologist - with at least one year equivalent to the GS-14 grade level
Demonstrated Knowledge - Skills - and Abilities
In addition to the experience above - the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Skill in managing and directing the work of large - complex organizational units and in applying effective management practices
Skill in persuasion - negotiation - and motivation to negotiate multiple program policies
Skill in interpersonal relationships in dealing with employees and other managers using advanced consultation and problem solving skills
Skill in the application and analysis of measurement tools to systems issues
Ability to balance responsibilities in a complex environment and to work with great autonomy
ability to set priorities and delegate tasks - meet multiple deadlines - analyze complex organizational problems
and ability to develop and implement effective solutions for those problems
Ability to assess need for basic and complex services across multiple programmatic contexts
Ability to coordinate the efforts of multiple program elements across a complex system
Reference: For more information on this qualification standard - please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/
The full performance level of this vacancy is GS-15
Physical Requirements: There are no physical requirements for this occupation per OCHCO Communications email to VA Handbook 5019 - updated on 4/17/2026.

Duties

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional The psychologist serves as a Senior Program Manager for the Outpatient Mental Health (OMH) program at the American Lake division of VA Puget Sound Health Care System (VAPSHCS) in Tacoma WA
In this capacity - the psychologist functions as the Director - OMH for the Mental Health Service Line
The Mental Health Service at the VAPSHCS is a large and diverse integrated care line with over 400 FTEE - including psychiatrists - psychologists - social workers - nurses - and several additional clinical and administrative staff
Senior Program Management Responsibilities (30%) Provides broad program management responsibilities of a clinical care team - including leadership in the development - implementation - evaluation - and oversight of a complex program responsible for comprehensive clinical care of Veterans
Leads a multidisciplinary team - which includes psychologists - physicians - physician assistants - social workers - nurses - and other health care professionals and trainees
Responsible for the development - implementation - and oversight of operational policies and procedures for the treatment team - with the approval of the affiliated Program Director and/or Service Line Leader
Monitors and distributes provider-specific workload reports to program managers and ensures provider adherence to workload standards
Plans work to be accomplished by program managers - including establishing priorities - timelines for completion - and necessary adjustments therein
Initiates and maintains liaisons with associated VA health care programs in order to effectively coordinate services

For these individuals - the incumbent provides administrative - as well as clinical - supervision and/or consultation as appropriate

Assumes responsibility for taking appropriate disciplinary actions for employees with performance problems in a timely and effective manner

Provides consultation to health care providers about assessment findings and treatment plan for patients to ensure that care is coordinated - collaborative - and integrated within the Medical Center

new_jobs.title: Task Order Manager - Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

The Task Order Manager - Program Manager is a leadership position responsible for the overall management, execution, performance, and growth of multiple federal government task orders and contracts supporting the Department of Energy (DOE), National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal agencies. The individual must be capable of independently managing assigned programs, building strong customer relationships, leading and developing personnel, addressing performance challenges, and identifying opportunities to improve contract execution and expand the company's federal portfolio.

The Task Order Manager - Program Manager serves as a primary point of contact for assigned contracts, ensuring contractual requirements, deliverables, performance standards, and customer expectations are consistently met.

In addition to day-to-day contract management, the position plays an important role in identifying opportunities for organic growth, expanding existing contract scope, supporting recompete strategies, and collaborating with Business Development and Capture teams to pursue new task orders and related business opportunities.

Essential Functions

Task Order and Program Management

Provide overall leadership, management, and oversight of multiple federal government task orders, ensuring successful execution in accordance with contractual requirements, company policies, and customer expectations.
Serve as the primary management point of contact for assigned task orders, maintaining effective communication with Government Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), Contracting Officers (COs), federal program managers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders, consistent with contractual authority and communication protocols.
Manage all aspects of task order execution, including contract initiation, transition, staffing, operational performance, deliverable management, option period planning, and contract closeout.
Ensure compliance with contract Statements of Work (SOWs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), and other applicable contract requirements.
Monitor contract performance, identify potential risks or performance deficiencies, and implement timely corrective actions to maintain customer satisfaction and contract compliance.
Oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of contract-specific management plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), processes, and reporting requirements.
Ensure contract deliverables, monthly status reports, financial reports, and other required submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted within established deadlines.
Coordinate with Project Controls, Contracts, Finance, Human Resources, Security, and other corporate departments to ensure efficient and effective task order operations.
Manage subcontractor and teaming partner performance, ensuring responsibilities, deliverables, staffing commitments, and contractual obligations are fulfilled.
Facilitate regular internal program reviews and customer meetings to evaluate contract performance, identify challenges, establish priorities, and implement improvements.
Maintain awareness of contract periods of performance, funding limitations, labor categories, staffing requirements, and upcoming contract milestones.
Identify opportunities to standardize processes, improve operational efficiencies, reduce administrative burdens, and enhance overall program performance.
Escalate significant contractual, financial, staffing, or performance concerns to appropriate company leadership with recommended courses of action.

Financial Management and Contract Performance

Maintain overall responsibility for the financial health and performance of assigned task orders, including revenue, profitability, expenditures, funding utilization, and labor management.
Develop, monitor, and maintain task order budgets, spend plans, staffing projections, and financial forecasts in coordination with Project Controls and Finance.
Monitor contract ceilings, obligated funding, labor utilization, burn rates, and funding requirements to prevent funding shortfalls, unauthorized expenditures, or interruptions in contract performance.
Review financial reports and contract performance metrics to identify trends, potential risks, and opportunities to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
Coordinate with Project Controls to ensure timely and accurate preparation, review, and submission of invoices, travel expenses, subcontractor costs, and other financial documentation.
Evaluate labor category assignments, staffing allocations, and resource utilization to ensure alignment with contract requirements and approved budgets.
Support contract modifications, funding requests, option period planning, and adjustments to staffing or contract scope.
Monitor actual expenditures against planned budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
Work with company leadership to establish and monitor financial performance objectives for assigned contracts.
Ensure contract management practices support company financial goals while maintaining compliance with applicable federal contracting requirements.

Personnel Management, Hiring, and Staffing

Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, hiring, onboarding, employee development, and retention for personnel assigned to managed task orders.
Evaluate current and projected staffing requirements to ensure appropriate personnel and resources are available to meet contract obligations.
Coordinate with Human Resources and Recruiting to develop position descriptions, identify qualified candidates, conduct interviews, and support hiring decisions.
Manage staffing transitions, employee replacements, vacancies, and surge requirements while minimizing disruptions to contract performance.
Provide leadership, direction, and support to assigned employees, ensuring personnel understand their responsibilities, performance expectations, and customer requirements.
Conduct employee performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, recognize outstanding performance, and identify professional development opportunities.
Address employee performance, attendance, conduct, and workplace concerns in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.
Promote employee engagement, professional growth, accountability, collaboration, and retention across assigned programs.
Maintain regular communication with employees and customer representatives to assess workload, staffing effectiveness, morale, and potential areas of concern.
Identify and develop employees capable of assuming additional responsibilities or leadership roles within existing and future contracts.
Coordinate employee compensation recommendations, promotions, retention strategies, and personnel actions with appropriate company leadership and Human Resources.
Ensure employees comply with company policies, contractual requirements, security procedures, timekeeping standards, and customer-specific workplace expectations.

Contract Growth, Business Development, and Capture Support

Identify and pursue opportunities for organic growth within assigned contracts, including additional staffing requirements, expanded scopes of work, new technical capabilities, and emerging customer needs.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with existing federal customers to strengthen customer satisfaction, increase contract retention, and position the company for future opportunities.
Collaborate with the Vice President, Business Development, Capture, and Proposal Development teams to identify and evaluate opportunities for new task orders, contract extensions, recompetes, and related federal work.
Monitor customer priorities, mission requirements, procurement forecasts, and upcoming contract opportunities to identify potential business growth.
Support the development of capture strategies by providing contract performance information, customer insights, staffing strategies, technical approaches, and operational lessons learned.
Contribute to the preparation and review of technical proposals, management approaches, staffing plans, transition plans, past performance narratives, and other proposal materials.
Assist with pricing strategies and labor category development by providing staffing projections, operational requirements, and knowledge of existing contract performance.
Participate in customer meetings, industry engagements, and teaming discussions to support business development and strategic positioning.
Identify potential teaming partners, subcontractors, and specialized resources that could strengthen existing contract execution or support new business opportunities.
Support contract recompete planning by identifying incumbent strengths, performance accomplishments, staffing considerations, and potential competitive risks.
Work with company leadership to establish realistic growth objectives for assigned programs and actively contribute to achieving those objectives.
Ensure business development and customer engagement activities are conducted in accordance with federal procurement integrity requirements and applicable organizational policies.

Strategic Leadership, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

Provide strategic and operational input to the Vice President, Senior Vice President, and executive leadership regarding contract performance, staffing requirements, financial risks, customer priorities, and business growth opportunities.
Develop and implement management strategies that support successful task order execution, employee performance, customer satisfaction, and organizational growth.
Identify and recommend improvements to internal processes, contract management procedures, reporting requirements, and resource allocation.
Ensure assigned contracts operate in accordance with applicable Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Department of Energy Acquisition Regulation (DEAR), contractual requirements, security procedures, and company policies.
Support the implementation and maintenance of company quality management standards, internal controls, and applicable ISO 9001 and CMMI processes.
Participate in internal program reviews, management assessments, compliance reviews, and audits as required.
Promote effective collaboration between Program Management, Project Controls, Contracts, Finance, Human Resources, Business Development, and other corporate departments.
Provide mentorship and guidance to junior program managers, task order leads, and other personnel as appropriate.
Contribute to corporate strategic planning initiatives by identifying operational improvements, emerging customer requirements, potential contract risks, and opportunities for continued growth.
Foster a culture of accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and exceptional customer service.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related field required.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in federal government contracting, program management, contract operations, or related fields.
At least 5 years of demonstrated experience managing federal contracts, task orders, programs, or multiple concurrent projects.
Demonstrated ability to manage contract budgets, labor utilization, financial forecasts, funding requirements, and overall contract profitability.

new_jobs.description:
Description

What if you could architect the programs that propel Amazon's fulfillment business to $1 trillion? We're building a newly created team with that singular mission — and we need a Technical Program Manager who can drive it.

This newly formed team sits at the intersection of Amazon's most ambitious growth vectors for Fulfilled by Amazon (FBA). We're targeting the segments with maximum untapped potential: High ASP products, Non-sort inventory, Multi-packs, and other under-penetrated categories that collectively represent hundreds of billions in addressable market. Our charter is to build the tech, mechanisms, and cross-functional execution muscle that unlocks step-function growth across these segments — spanning hundreds of fulfillment centers worldwide and impacting hundreds of billions in annual GMS.

This isn’t “TPM as status-tracker.” This is a TPM as the chief orchestrator of large-scale, cross-functional programs that reshape Fulfilled by Amazon. We’re looking for a force multiplier who uses AI as a superpower to accelerate program delivery, automate decision-making, and drive execution at a pace that matches our ambition. Someone who thinks in systems, communicates with surgical precision, builds mechanisms that scale globally, and delivers programs that move atoms at the speed of bits.

Key job responsibilities

Drive Large Cross-Functional Programs

Lead end-to-end program execution for High ASP, Non-sort, and Multi-pack initiatives that expand FBA’s addressable market to $1T
Define and drive cross-functional program roadmaps spanning engineering, science, operations, and business teams to deliver category-specialized fulfillment solutions
Build and own program mechanisms (business reviews, escalation paths, dependency tracking) that ensure on-time delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives across segments with maximum growth potential
Identify and resolve cross-organizational dependencies, remove blockers, and drive alignment across SVP organizations to accelerate speed-to-market for new fulfillment capabilities

AI-First Program Execution

Deploy generative AI and agentic systems to automate program tracking, risk identification, stakeholder communication, and decision-making — AI is not a feature, it’s your operating system
Use AI to 10x program velocity: LLM-powered status synthesis, automated dependency mapping, AI-generated risk assessments, and generative AI for mechanism design and documentation

Cross-Geography, Cross-Organization Impact

Drive program execution across WW geographies (US, EU, CA, IN, JP), each with unique regulatory, operational, and market constraints requiring tailored approaches
Partner directly with senior leaders across multiple SVP organizations
Coordinate cross-functional execution for growth categories to unlock category-specialized fulfillment at global scale

About The Team

The Defect Prevention and Reconciliation (DP&R) organization builds innovative technical products that recognize, reconcile, and prevent exceptions within Amazon’s fulfillment supply chain. We are building a future where we capture, analyze, and explain every inventory defect across all stages of the supply chain (i.e. inbound, distribution, storage, fulfillment, returns). The Support Operations Tools and Automation team, within DP&R, owns the system technology, and tools used by the DP&R Support Operations to onboard, investigate and audit WW Seller and Vendor contacts to Amazon.

This core-team sits within DP&R and focuses on high value items on Amazon Store.

7+ years of technical product or program management experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Prime Video is changing the way hundreds of millions of customers interact with video content. Amazon believes so deeply in the mission of streaming video that we've launched our own studio to create original and exclusive content and engaged with the top professional sports leagues around the world — including the NFL, Premier League, and NBA — to deliver compelling live content to Prime members.

You'll have the opportunity to work across many groups within and outside Prime Video while getting deep insights into our entire business.

The Senior TPM role requires excellent leadership skills, strategic thinking, strong technical expertise, the ability to partner effectively across teams within and outside of Amazon, and the ability to manage high-impact projects. As a member of the team, you’ll need to have the ability to understand the fundamentals of the latest video technology and what it takes to launch large scale video services and features that involve multiple teams within and outside of Prime Video. We're a high energy, fast growth business excited to have the opportunity to shape how video is consumed for years to come.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Program Manager / Product Lifecycle (PLM) Program Manager to provide end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-functional programs across the product lifecycle—from concept and New Product Introduction (NPI) through release, sustaining, and end-of-life. This role drives execution excellence by building and managing integrated schedules, aligning dependencies across engineering and partner teams, enforcing PDLC governance, and ensuring delivery commitments are met on time and within budget.

The ideal candidate brings 6–10+ years of program/project management experience (including 5+ years in Agile environments), strong hands-on expertise with Jira (3+ years) and Smartsheet (2+ years), and a track record of leading executive-level communications, risk management, and milestone readiness reviews. Success requires exceptional stakeholder management, structured problem solving, and the ability to remove roadblocks and drive decisions across Product, Engineering, Manufacturing, and external partners to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Provides support and/or leads teams through the engineering development process and implementation of the company’s products. Projects are typically shorter-term, less complex, and more contained with a defined timeframe. Programs are typically longer-term, multi-functional, multi-project efforts with complex requirements and dependencies. Requires 6+ years
of hands-on program/project management experience managing activities, resource capability, integrated schedules, budgets, and cross-company communications to facilitate product completion on schedule and within budget
. Requires demonstrated experience ( 4+ years
) driving program execution using formal governance, identifying risks/dependencies early, and improving process and program efficiencies in partnership with engineering leadership. Work may involve external parties such as standards bodies, partners, suppliers, and/or customers.

For qualified candidates in the continental United States that are US citizens, we may be open to other locations outside of those listed on the req

Management Level Definition

Contributions regularly and sustainably impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Typically requires 6+ years
experience, including 5+ years
working directly with engineering and program cross-functional teams, and 3+ years
influencing delivery commitments and outcomes with senior stakeholders. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best methods for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.

Responsibilities

Manages and leads a program involving multiple functions and project teams to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a product or service offering, typically requiring 5+ years experience coordinating cross-functional execution.
Develops and directs the development of integrated schedules, critical deliverables, budget, resource allocation plans, and other support requirements for assigned programs; requires 4+ years of schedule ownership ensuring milestones and timelines are met.
Manages activities of supporting project teams and internal development partners; ensures progress against established plans and uses analysis of business and execution data to alter or update schedules and resource allocations to meet product requirements and development schedules; requires 4+ years experience driving recovery plans for slipping milestones.
Communicates program progress, escalations, and issue analysis to product stakeholders; collaborates with management and internal manufacturing and development partners to recommend and implement changes to products, processes, or business practices to resolve escalated issues, produce solutions, and ensure adherence to budgets and established roadmaps and schedules; requires 3+ years presenting status, risks, and trade-offs to senior management.
Drives innovation and integration of new technologies and quality initiatives into projects and activities in the manufacturing and/or engineering organization; requires 3+ years contributing to measurable process improvements (e.g., improved predictability, reduced cycle time, improved on-time delivery).
Leads and provides guidance and mentoring to less-experienced staff members; typically 2+ years of informal or formal mentoring/leadership responsibilities.

Education And Experience Required

6+ years overall experience in program/project management, engineering program management, or technical program management.
5+ years in an Agile environment (Scrum/Kanban/hybrid) supporting engineering delivery
5+ years of New Product Introduction (NPI) and/or product release execution ownership
5+ years’ experience coordinating cross-functional execution.
5+ years working directly with engineering and program cross-functional teams,
3+ years influencing delivery commitments and outcomes with senior stakeholders
4+ years driving program execution using formal governance, identifying risks/dependencies early, and improving process and program efficiencies in partnership with engineering leadership.
4+ years of extensive experience using project and program planning tools and software packages to create, manage, and track project results (e.g., Jira and Smartsheet).
4+ years of schedule ownership ensuring milestones and timelines are met.
4+ years’ experience driving recovery plans for slipping milestones.
3+ years’ operating at senior stakeholder level.
3+ years presenting status, risks, and trade-offs to senior management.
3+ years contributing to measurable process improvements (e.g., improved predictability, reduced cycle time, improved on-time delivery).
3+ years hands-on experience using Jira for program execution tracking and stakeholder reporting
2+ years hands-on experience using Smartsheet to build and maintain program schedules and reporting
2+ years of informal or formal mentoring/leadership responsibilities.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with 3+ years’ experience using execution metrics to drive corrective actions.
Demonstrated business acumen with 4+ years successfully managing program scope, schedule, budget, and resources, including communicating with stakeholders and directing matrixed teams and resources.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business management, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or equivalent experience.
PMP/PMI certification preferred.

Knowledge And Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
Ability to effectively communicate program plans, proposals, and results, and negotiate options at senior management levels; typically 3+ years operating at senior stakeholder level.

Unconditional Inclusion
