new_jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Position Summary

Imagine using your analytical expertise to improve warranty performance, service effectiveness, repair quality, dealer execution, and customer uptime. In this role, you will turn complex warranty, claims, diagnostic, repair, telematics, and service data into trusted insights and practical recommendations for the Volvo and Mack brands.

As a Warranty & Service Intelligence Analyst, you will provide decision-ready insights across warranty claims, repair activity, diagnostics, service operations, dealer performance, vehicle quality, and customer uptime. You will translate business questions into analytical solutions, strengthen data quality and reporting consistency, identify emerging trends and risks, and support actions that improve warranty outcomes, service performance, and customer experience.

Imagine using your analytical expertise to improve warranty performance, service effectiveness, repair quality, dealer execution, and customer uptime. In this role, you will turn complex warranty, claims, diagnostic, repair, telematics, and service data into trusted insights and practical recommendations for the Volvo and Mack brands.

As a Warranty & Service Intelligence Analyst, you will provide decision-ready insights across warranty claims, repair activity, diagnostics, service operations, dealer performance, vehicle quality, and customer uptime. You will translate business questions into analytical solutions, strengthen data quality and reporting consistency, identify emerging trends and risks, and support actions that improve warranty outcomes, service performance, and customer experience.

What You Will Do

Warranty, Claims, and Quality Intelligence

Analyze warranty claims, repair histories, labor and parts usage, failure patterns, diagnostic information, and cost trends across products, dealers, fleets, and vehicle populations.
Identify unusual claim populations, recurring failure modes, cost drivers, and emerging warranty or quality trends for business review and follow-up.
Develop forecasts, scenarios, and analytical models that estimate warranty exposure, repair demand, operational impact, and potential financial outcomes.

Service, Dealer, and Uptime Intelligence

Analyze service activity, repair cycle time, repeat repairs, dealer performance, diagnostic effectiveness, and vehicle uptime indicators.
Create dealer and fleet views that highlight service performance, warranty trends, improvement opportunities, and areas requiring further investigation.
Partner with Warranty, Technical Support, Field Service, Uptime, and dealer-facing teams to convert findings into targeted actions and measurable follow-up.

Decision Support and Storytelling

Partner with business stakeholders to translate warranty and service questions into clearly defined analytical problems, metrics, and recommendations.
Build executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, analytical summaries, and business cases for operating reviews, quality discussions, planning, and improvement initiatives.
Communicate findings in clear business language, distinguish facts from hypotheses, recommend next steps, and track whether actions produce the intended outcome.

Advanced Analytics, Automation, and Continuous Improvement

Automate recurring warranty and service reporting to improve speed, consistency, scalability, and access to decision support.
Support predictive analytics and responsible AI use cases related to claim behavior, repair needs, failure risk, cost exposure, and service performance.
Apply structured continuous-improvement methods to map workflows, identify gaps, conduct root-cause analysis, establish standards, and measure sustained improvement.

Data Management, Governance, and Integration

Develop and maintain dashboards, semantic models, reusable datasets, reporting packages, and analytical documentation.
Support standardized KPI definitions, data-quality controls, validation routines, and trusted reporting for warranty, diagnostics, repairs, telematics, and service operations.
Partner with DTO, D&IT, Data Engineering, GTO, GTT, and business stakeholders to improve data accessibility, architecture, integration, and reporting scalability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Warranty, Services, Uptime, Technical Support, Field Service, Quality, Product, Finance, Operations, DTO, D&IT, GTO, GTT, dealers, and fleet stakeholders.
Balance multiple analytical priorities, surface data limitations and dependencies early, and contribute as a collaborative individual contributor within a data-driven culture.
Benchmark relevant practices across internal teams and comparable operations to identify practical opportunities for improvement.

Who are you?

You are analytically curious, detail oriented, and comfortable working across technical, operational, and business teams. You can move from claim-level or repair-level data to an executive-level story, challenge assumptions constructively, and connect analysis to decisions and measurable outcomes. This is an individual-contributor role without people-management responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, warranty analytics, service analytics, quality analytics, or a related role.
Experience developing decision-support dashboards and data models using Power BI or a comparable platform.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, including data validation, modeling, and analysis of large or multi-source datasets.
Experience defining metrics, identifying trends and anomalies, and communicating analytical recommendations to business stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, presentation, and project-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with warranty claims, repair orders, service operations, diagnostics, telematics, dealer networks, fleets, truck, automotive, heavy equipment, transportation, or manufacturing data.
Experience with ERP, dealer management, warranty, diagnostic, telematics, data-warehouse, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics environments.
Experience with statistical modeling or machine-learning methods such as regression, time series, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, or predictive maintenance.
Experience using DAX, Python, R, SAS, Power Automate, or comparable analytical and automation tools.
Experience applying Lean, Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, PDCA, DMAIC, root-cause analysis, process mapping, or a comparable continuous-improvement framework.

Key Success Measures

Actionable warranty and service insights adopted in operating reviews, quality investigations, dealer improvement plans, and business decisions.
Improved visibility into claim patterns, failure trends, repair performance, warranty cost drivers, dealer performance, and vehicle uptime.
Reduced manual reporting effort and improved speed, scalability, and accessibility of warranty and service decision support.
Improved consistency, documentation, and trust in warranty, repair, diagnostic, telematics, and service KPIs and datasets.
Clear measurement of outcomes from analytical, process-improvement, and predictive initiatives.

Ready for the next move?

Join a team that is transforming warranty and service data into decisions and helping improve quality, uptime, dealer performance, and customer support across Volvo Group.

At the Volvo Group, we strive for a clear, transparent, and straightforward compensation approach, motivating you to contribute to the company’s growth. For this position, the base pay is set at $96,000 - $118,500 annually, and where applicable, bonus eligible.  The range for this role, as well as final salary offered, is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, work-related knowledge, certifications, skills, education, and experience. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as part of any final offer.

In addition to a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy:  

Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance.
Generous paid time off.

Working environment where your safety, health and wellbeing come first.
Focus on professional and personal development through Volvo Group University.
Programs that make today’s challenging reality of combining work and personal life easier.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. is an iconic brand that embodies the American spirit: pioneering, hard-working, authentic and ambitious. Mack trucks are recognized around the world as “The American Truck You Can Count On,” thanks to our durable, reliable and application-driven vehicles that get the job done.

, founded in Sweden in the late 1920s, is a brand centered around innovating for people – to make life easier, better, and safer. By joining our North American Group Truck brands (Volvo & Mack)
, you will be part of a global and diverse team, where we work with passion, we trust each other, and we embrace change to stay ahead. By working together, we can provide innovative solutions that add value over time and help us create the world we want to live in.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Engine AI Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we obsess over our customers and maintaining their trust. To earn that trust in an environment as vast and varied as Amazon's requires the applied skills of experienced and innovative Technical Program Managers to tackle challenges at Amazon scale.

We are seeking a Sr. Technical Program Manager to lead AI Native Transformation efforts on the Engine team. Engine delivers platform tooling that allows all Amazon employees to innovate, from capacity management, availability and incident management, and infrastructure hosting, to 1P and 3P productivity tooling, corporate access, foundational AI platforms, and the hardware Amazonians use to do their jobs. We are looking for an individual who can lead technical initiatives, build and maintain strategic relationships with internal and external partners, define and implement repeatable processes, and deliver results across a complex landscape. If you are passionate about building processes and technology that directly impact all Amazonians and want to join a team shaping the future of AI Native delivery at Amazon, we want to talk to you.

You will own the mechanisms that turn our AI enablement strategy into adoption across Engine. You will partner with a Principal Engineer to identify best practices, experiment with frontier teams, and roll mature practices out to every Engine team. You will run the monthly AI Native business review, own the retrospective cycle that sharpens our mechanisms, curate central resources (agent templates, shared skill packs, adoption playbooks), and influence teams to deliver productivity tooling that supports AI Native workflows. Success takes maturity, high judgment, negotiation, influence, analytical talent, and leadership through ambiguity.

You will work across teams and through ambiguity. You thrive by building consensus and driving teams toward results. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance business needs against technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex programs and break them down into manageable pieces to deliver them on time is essential. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent, and leadership are critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

Own the planning, execution, and delivery of the AI Native Transformation program across Engine, from experiment through org-wide rollout. Partner with the Principal Engineer to identify best practices, define the mechanisms that drive adoption, establish milestones, identify critical-path dependencies, and drive teams to deliver on schedule.
Run the monthly business review for leadership: define metrics, report on progress against goals, and frame the decisions leadership needs to make.
Identify common knowledge-worker workflows, rebuild them AI-natively, and influence the teams that build Amazon's productivity tooling to deliver those solutions as product features, extending Engine's work to every Amazonian.
Coordinate across engineering teams, central tooling partners, and enablement teams to align priorities, resolve cross-organizational blockers, and build lasting partnerships with stakeholders at all levels.
Curate the central resources teams rely on, including default agent templates, shared skill packs, and adoption playbooks.
Program the organization's AI upskilling, working with the enablement team and role leads to schedule trainings, workshops, and office hours.
Run the retrospective cycle each period, turning what teams report and what the metrics show into mechanism changes that raise adoption over time.

About The Team

Our customers are Amazonians, every one of them. We build the technology that keeps the whole company productive, from the systems that keep Amazon's websites running to the productivity tools, corporate access, AI platforms, and hardware people use every day. Our mission is to foster invention for all Amazonians, and right now we are making that work AI-native. You would work closely with a principal engineer to define best practices, with builder teams to transform how they work, and with the teams who own productivity tooling to shape the features that bring AI-native workflows to every Amazonian.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video
new_jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video (PV) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own Operational Excellence and Development Efficiency across the business. Reporting directly to the Director of READI, this is a strategic, single-threaded leadership role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and can set direction where the problem itself is not yet defined.

As a Principal TPM, you will operate across VP organizations, exercising broad strategic influence over how Prime Video plans, measures, and improves the operational health of its services and the productivity of its engineers. You will own high-visibility operating mechanisms — most notably the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review — and set the overall strategy, goals, and initiatives for Operational Excellence across PV. You will manage significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives, remediate endemic problems, and force-multiply your impact through the mechanisms and standards you create. This is a role for someone who is regularly escalated to, rather than one who escalates.

Key job responsibilities

Operational Excellence Strategy & Goals

Define and own the multi-year strategy, annual goals, and initiative portfolio for Operational Excellence across Prime Video, aligning teams and organizations toward a simple, coherent approach.

Establish the operational metrics, standards, and paved-road practices that define what “good” looks like for PV services — covering availability, resilience, incident management, and operational readiness.

Set and track org-level operational goals planning, translating leadership priorities into measurable outcomes and holding teams accountable to them.

Remediate critical and endemic operational problems by identifying systemic root causes and driving durable, cross-org fixes rather than point solutions.

High-Visibility Mechanisms (PV Quarterly Operations Review)

Own the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review end-to-end — its agenda, data, narrative, and follow-through — as the authoritative forum where PV leadership inspects operational health and commits to improvements.

Design, run, and continuously improve the portfolio of operating mechanisms (weekly/monthly business and ops reviews, metrics dashboards, and governance cadences) that create predictable inspection and drive action.

Curate crisp, accurate, and timely written narratives and data for senior leaders (up to and including VPs and S-Team-facing readouts), ensuring decisions are well-informed and action items are tracked to closure.

Create the connective tissue between mechanisms so that signals surfaced in one forum reliably drive prioritization, resourcing, and roadmap decisions across PV.

Development Efficiency

Own the strategy for improving developer productivity and delivery velocity across PV — reducing friction in the software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations.

Define and instrument developer efficiency metrics (e.g., build and deployment health, cycle time, change failure rate, time-to-recover) and use them to target the highest-leverage investments.

Drive adoption of paved-road tooling, standards, and best practices that simplify how PV teams build and operate, eliminating undifferentiated heavy lifting and unnecessary process.

Partner with builder-tools and infrastructure teams to unblock innovation and increase the speed and safety of delivery at scale.

Cross-Org Influence & Force Multiplication

Operate across VP organizations with broad strategic influence, building consensus, securing commitments, and negotiating positive outcomes among senior engineering and product leaders.

Drive clarity in ambiguity — frame problems that are not yet defined, align stakeholders on the path forward, and deliver with complete independence.

Force-multiply through the mechanisms, standards, and structures you create, raising the operational bar across teams without being in the critical path of every decision.

Actively develop the TPM community at PV — mentoring senior TPMs, contributing to promotion assessments, and elevating program-management craft across the organization.

A day in the life

No two days look the same, but the through-line is mechanism ownership and strategic influence. You might begin the morning diving deep into operational metrics ahead of the Quarterly Operations Review — pressure-testing the data, sharpening the narrative, and pre-aligning VP-org leaders on the decisions that need to be made. Midday, you facilitate a working session with engineering directors to unblock a cross-org resilience initiative, making the trade-off calls between business opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability.

In the afternoon, you shift to development efficiency — reviewing delivery-velocity trends, identifying the systemic bottlenecks slowing teams down, and shaping the paved-road investments that will remove them. Throughout, you are the person leaders are escalated to when operational health is at risk, and the owner who ensures every commitment coming out of a mechanism is tracked to closure. Your success is measured not by the work you personally execute, but by the durable systems, standards, and mechanisms you leave behind.

About The Team

READI is a central function in Prime Video that drives strategy, tooling, and programs for Scale Readiness, Operational Excellence, Resilience & Observability, and Development Efficiency. READI’s value as a central team relies heavily on outward-facing influence: its strategy, decisions, and guidance are amplified across all of PV. Prime Video operates a global, high-scale streaming service, spending hundreds of millions in infrastructure and allocating hundreds of engineers to operational load each year — a surface area where disciplined operational rigor and improved development efficiency translate directly into customer experience, cost, and speed of innovation.

Today, ownership of PV-wide Operational Excellence strategy and its supporting mechanisms is distributed, creating diffusion of responsibility and inconsistent standards across teams. This role exists to close that gap: to be the single-threaded owner who defines what operational excellence means for PV, instruments it, runs the mechanisms that inspect it, and drives the initiatives that continuously raise the bar.

Basic Qualifications

12+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
10+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst
to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.
Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.
Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.
Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.
Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.
Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.
Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.
Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.
Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.
Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.
Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.
Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.
Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.
Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.
Familiarity with billing or metering systems.
SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.
Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.
Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

new_jobs.title: Biosafety and Biosecurity Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

Congratulations on taking control of your career! We’re pleased you’re exploring opportunities to evolve and adapt your professional life. MITRE's diversity of sponsor missions, research areas, and cross-corporate capabilities translates into hundreds of meaningful projects at any given time. We invite you to discover how your unique combination of strengths and experiences can benefit our work program in new ways.

MITRE Technology and Engineering is seeking a Biosafety and Biosecurity Analyst with experience or demonstrated knowledge in biosafety and biosecurity risk assessments, infectious disease research, and supporting research oversight committees (e.g., institutional review boards, institutional animal care and use committees, biosafety committees, and/or institutional review entities). The analyst will support multidisciplinary scientific and technical reviews of life sciences research with potential biosafety, biosecurity, public health, and national security implications.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Scientific and Technical Reviews: Contribute to multidisciplinary scientific and technical reviews of life sciences research with potential biosafety, biosecurity, public health, or national security implications. Evaluate and synthesize scientific and technical information to identify key considerations, information gaps, and areas requiring additional analysis. Develop technical summaries, background materials, briefing materials, assessments, recommendations, and other decision-support products in collaboration with senior staff and subject matter experts. Clearly communicate complex scientific, risk, and policy information to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Coordinate and Support Review Meetings: Coordinate scientific and technical review activities from initial intake through review, documentation, resolution, and follow-up. Plan and execute review meetings, including coordinating participants and technical expertise, preparing materials, managing logistics, documenting deliberations and outcomes, and tracking follow-up actions. Engage with review participants to obtain necessary information, resolve questions, and facilitate timely completion of review activities. Maintain accurate records, status information, metrics, and supporting documentation.
Develop and Apply Expertise: Contribute expertise across a broader portfolio of work involving biological risk, biodefense, health security, emerging biotechnology, and related national security challenges. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to address complex scientific, technical, and policy problems. Continue to build and develop expertise to meet critical sponsor challenges.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Academic background or professional experience in infectious disease, microbiology, virology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, public health, biosafety, biosecurity, or related discipline.
Knowledge of infectious disease and the scientific principles relevant to biological research.
Knowledge of biosafety and biosecurity principles and their application to life sciences research.
Knowledge of U.S. policies, frameworks, or guidance related to dangerous gain of function research, biosafety, and biosecurity.
Familiarity with risk assessment or risk management approaches associated with life sciences research and emerging biotechnologies.
Ability to analyze and synthesize complex scientific and technical information and communicate key findings accurately.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop clear technical summaries, briefing materials, and other written products.
Strong organization skills and attention to detail, with the ability to coordinate multiple activities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet deadlines.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with scientific and technical subject matter experts.
Ability to exercise sound judgement and discretion when working with sensitive scientific and technical information.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week on-site

Preferred Qualifications:

Professional experience related to biosafety, biosecurity, biological risk assessment, biodefense, or health security.
Experience evaluating scientific literature or research involving infectious agents, host-pathogen interactions, pathogenicity, transmissibility, virulence, and other characteristics relevant to biological risk.
Experience supporting scientific or technical reviews, advisory groups, working groups, or other multidisciplinary technical activities.
Experience supporting or participating in research compliance committees such as institutional biosafety committees, institutional review entities, institutional animal care and use committees, or institutional review boards.
Demonstrated ability to develop new subject matter expertise quickly and apply that knowledge across multiple projects or problem areas.

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

None

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret/SCI

Salary compensation range and midpoint:

$92,800 - $116,000 - $139,200 Annual

Work Location Type:

Onsite

Develop technical summaries, background materials, briefing materials, assessments, recommendations, and other decision-support products in collaboration with senior staff and subject matter experts. Clearly communicate complex scientific, risk, and policy information to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Coordinate and Support Review Meetings: Coordinate scientific and technical review activities from initial intake through review, documentation, resolution, and follow-up. Plan and execute review meetings, including coordinating participants and technical expertise, preparing materials, managing logistics, documenting deliberations and outcomes, and tracking follow-up actions. Engage with review participants to obtain necessary information, resolve questions, and facilitate timely completion of review activities. Maintain accurate records, status information, metrics, and supporting documentation.
Develop and Apply Expertise: Contribute expertise across a broader portfolio of work involving biological risk, biodefense, health security, emerging biotechnology, and related national security challenges. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to address complex scientific, technical, and policy problems. Continue to build and develop expertise to meet critical sponsor challenges.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; Master’s degree with a minimum of 3 years of related experience; a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Academic background and demonstrated professional experience in infectious disease, microbiology, virology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, public health, biosafety, biosecurity, or related discipline.
Demonstrated knowledge of infectious disease and the scientific principles relevant to biological research, with the ability to critically evaluate complex life sciences research and identify potential biological risks.
Demonstrated knowledge of biosafety and biosecurity principles and experience applying these principles to life sciences research, research oversight, risk assessment, or related activities.
Demonstrated knowledge of and ability to apply U.S. policies, frameworks, or guidance related to dangerous gain of function research, biosafety, and biosecurity.
Experience applying risk assessment or risk management approaches to life sciences research and emerging biotechnologies.
Demonstrated ability to independently evaluate and synthesize complex scientific and technical information, identify key considerations and information gaps, and determine when additional technical expertise or analysis is needed.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the demonstrated ability to develop clear technical summaries, briefing materials, and other written products for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organization skills and attention to detail, with the ability to coordinate multiple activities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet deadlines.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with scientific and technical subject matter experts.
Ability to exercise sound judgement and discretion when working with sensitive scientific and technical information.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated professional experience related to biosafety, biosecurity, biological risk assessment, biodefense, health security, or oversight of life sciences research.
Experience conducting or leading risk assessments involving infectious disease research, biological agents, emerging biotechnology, or other potentially high-consequence life sciences research.
Experience evaluating scientific literature or research involving infectious agents, host-pathogen interactions, pathogenicity, transmissibility, virulence, and other characteristics relevant to biological risk.
Experience leading or coordinating scientific or technical reviews, advisory groups, working groups, or other multidisciplinary technical activities.
Experience supporting or participating in research compliance committees such as institutional biosafety committees, institutional review entities, institutional animal care and use committees, or institutional review boards.
Experience synthesizing multidisciplinary technical deliberations and translating findings into assessments, recommendations, or other decision-support products.
Demonstrated ability to develop new subject matter expertise quickly and apply that knowledge across multiple projects or problem areas.
Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex and ambiguous problems, exercise technical judgment, and identify appropriate paths forward.

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst (London)
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based remotely out of London, UK.

Regional Expectations

Based in London with strong overlap to customer business hours.
Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst
to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.
Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.
Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.
Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.
Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.
Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.
Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.
Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.
Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.
Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.
Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.
Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.
Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.
Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.
Familiarity with billing or metering systems.
SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.
Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.
Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

Notice
: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

new_jobs.title: (Remote) Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Systems & Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager

Systems and Software (www.ssivt.com), a division of Harris Computer Systems, is a software development company headquartered in Winooski, VT. S&S's single focus is on delivering horizontally and vertically scalable customer service solutions to the utility industry. Our reputation is one of market-leading software, exceptional solution delivery, and a customer-focused organization.

For a utility, a Customer Information System (CIS) is more than just a collection of records, it's a lifeline between the utility and its most important asset, its customers. From turn-on to move-out, no other system will have the impact on the customer experience that the CIS does, so ensuring that this solution offers the breadth of scope and responsiveness that modern consumers require is a critical priority. Through our flagship product, enQuesta, S&S meets this need for our electric, water, sewer and gas customers by combining an intuitive design with powerful technology. The enQuesta solution not only presents a modern, innovative face for the utility to the end customers, but also enables the utilities to take advantage of the solution's open architecture when developing future programs and initiatives.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 75%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. This opportunity can be performed remotely or from our office in Winooski, VT. Travel, depending on the project(s).

Salary

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Project Coordination & Management

Coordinate components of utility CIS software implementation projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Maintain and update detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets to ensure projects remain on track.
Identify and report issues, risks, or delays in a timely manner to the PMO Manager and stakeholders for resolution.
Provide clear communication and regular updates on project progress to the PMO Manager and project teams.

Process Support & Standardization

Assist the PMO Manager in maintaining project management documentation and processes to ensure consistency across projects.
Adhere to established project management methodologies, including Waterfall and Agile, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with project management practices and help identify areas for administrative efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication

Maintain consistent communication with internal teams, including R&D, Sales, and Delivery, to ensure alignment on project tasks.

Financial Tracking & Reporting

Assist in monitoring project budgets, ensuring expenses are tracked against financial goals.
Track and report on project status, timelines, and financials, generating regular status reports for the PMO Manager.
Collaborate with finance teams to verify financial data aligns with forecasts.

Performance Monitoring

Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as project delivery timelines and budget variance.
Assist in analyzing project execution data to contribute ideas for enhancing team efficiency.
Support the PMO Manager in preparing project status updates and gathering data for issue escalation.
Participate in client-facing discussions, documenting meeting minutes and action items to ensure customer satisfaction.

What We Are Looking For

1-3 years of experience in project management or a related role, preferably within software implementations or technical environments.
Experience in managing project budgets ranging from $10k to over $2.5M.
Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Spira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Clarizen.
Basic understanding of Waterfall project management; exposure to Agile methodologies is a plus.
Experience tracking project financials or budgets is preferred.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with team members and customers.
Ability to work collaboratively and manage tasks with guidance.
Strong problem-solving abilities with a focus on learning and delivering results.
Experience working in a team-oriented environment, collaborating with cross-functional groups such as Sales, R&D, and Delivery.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on organization and process.
Position may require travel as high as 75% in North America without restriction.
Frequent communication through Teams, phone calls, and email to stay connected with remote teams and leadership.

What We Can Offer

3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
Lifestyle rewards
Remote work and more!

About Systems & Software

Systems & Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems & Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

About Harris

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Human Evaluations (Recommendations)
new_jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Job Description

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

About The Role

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will partner across product, research, data science, UX, and engineering to develop rubrics, frameworks, and workflows that enable rigorous, scalable human evaluation of recommendations. Beyond shaping the "what" and "how," you will also lead the "when" and "done." You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end execution of human evaluation and data operations initiatives, from intake and scoping to delivery
Partner with Product Management to translate recommendation strategy and roadmap priorities into evaluation designs, success metrics, and timelines
Manage human annotation vendors, including capacity planning, SLAs, quality performance, and escalations
Drive operational efficiency across evaluation programs, including cost per task, throughput, turnaround time, and speed to IRR
Develop clear, scalable guidelines and scoring rubrics to ensure consistent rater judgment, including for subjective, taste-based questions
Oversee rater onboarding, calibration, and QA workflows
Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale

Qualifications

4+ years of experience working in human evaluations, data collection, labeling, or annotation operations in ML environments
Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems for data collection needs
Prior experience managing human annotation vendors, raters, or data labeling teams, including vendor performance and cost management
Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)
Strong understanding of evaluation design, including guidelines, rubrics, and scoring protocols
Working fluency in film and TV content, including genres, formats, and talent
Proven ability in end-to-end management of complex, cross-functional programs, demonstrating strong Program Management skills and clear accountability for successful delivery
Experience with human labeling platforms
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to synthesize feedback into clear recommendations and process improvements
Familiarity with how rater subjectivity and bias affect taste-based judgments, and how to account for them in evaluation design
Strong organizational skills and executional focus; ability to track details while seeing the bigger picture

Nice To Have

Experience with personalization, recommender systems, search, or ranking evaluation
Familiarity with how offline human evaluation complements online experimentation (A/B tests) and engagement metrics
Experience evaluating at the list or page level, not only the individual item level
Experience partnering with Product Managers and Data Scientists on metric definition

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $230,000.00 - $360,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
